name: Ok-Opun
code:
ularianexplorer_1_desc: "My Emperor, word from the small seaside city of [GetProvince('(int32)2422').GetName|G] is that a local lord has gathered a small group of local #T Helluvian#! converts for a voyage abroad. Their motives are uncertain, but they are likely fleeing persecution by our officials and priests, for their faith is forbidden in our empire.

We suspect that he intends to lead them to either the #G Bloody Isles#! or the #G Lands of the Snakefolk#!. Whichever course he takes, he will almost certainly meet his end at the hands of some uncivilized despot.

The expedition is led by a young #Y Ularian#! nobleman by the name of [GetCharacter('(int32)330').GetName|Y]. Caught worshipping the false god #T Hellas#!, he was sentenced to death by your decree but escaped our custody. He is believed to have hidden in the nearby forests, gathering followers and preparing for this journey.

These fugitives pose no threat to our rule. Sending imperial troops after them would waste men and coin merely to keep a few heathen families within our borders. Surely Your Imperial Majesty agrees?"

name: Ok-Opun
code: ularianexplorer_1_tooltip.a: "[GetCharacter('(int32)330').GetName|Y] will sail off to find a new homeland for his people!"

name: Ok-Opun
code:
ularianexplorer_2_desc: "My liege, unfamiliar ships have arrived in the harbor of [GetProvince('(int32)2187').GetName|G]! They carry #Y Geallian#! families under the command of a captain who calls himself [GetCharacter('(int32)330').GetName|Y].

As far as we can gather from his broken #Y Orcish#!, his people are fleeing persecution in [GetCountry('WGA').GetName|T], seeking a homeland among the #Y Snakefolk#! where they can practice their faith in peace. He asks for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y]'s help with his voyage, hoping to procure supplies for the long journey.

While the aggressive and isolationist #Y Snakefolk#! are likely to attack this vulnerable band of farmers and herders, the explorer's account of his god has intrigued many at court. In his stirring sermons, he speaks of #T Hellas#!, who teaches his followers to strengthen their own #T Inner Flame#! by nurturing the flames of those whose light burns weakest. A curious teaching indeed!

After he leaves, the chiefs offer their counsel to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y]. Some demand the expulsion of the stranger, stating that no #Y Shuar#! are to be trusted, while others say that he should be sent away with supplies, as the #Y Geallians#! are active supporters of our country. The more curious chieftains suggest keeping the stranger in our service so that he might teach us the ways of #T Hellas#!. There are already followers of his faith in [GetProvince('(int32)2199').GetName|G]; granting him that settlement in return for service would give his followers a home while keeping their leader under our authority."

name: Ok-Opun
code:
ularianexplorer_6_desc: "Chief, #Y humans#! have arrived on our shores! These are not the cruel #Y Eptelonians#! or #Y Arteonians#!, but a people who call themselves '#Y Geallian#!'.

Their leader, a man named [GetCharacter('(int32)330').GetName|Y], asks for supplies to sustain his people on their journey, along with directions to lands beyond the reach of any great kingdom.

Eptelonians, #Y Geallians#!, or whatever else they choose to call themselves, our people have no love for #Y humans#!. If we spare them, the cruel [GetCountry('UPJ').GetName|T] will surely finish them off."

name: Ok-Opun
code:
ularianexplorer_7_desc: "My King, a foreigner calling himself [GetCharacter('(int32)330').GetName|Y] has requested an audience with you.

While I am aware of your decree to kill all #Y humans#! on sight, he is unlike the #Y Eptelonians#! and #Y Arteonians#! who once raided our shores. His people have pale skin and claim to come from the #T Sani Empire#!.

He asks for land where his people can settle and offers to become your vassal in return.

News of the southern continents is scarce, and his knowledge of mathematics and the sciences is impressive for a #Y human#!. He could prove a useful vassal, bringing unfamiliar skills to the lands entrusted to him.

However, he is still #Y human#!, a race more deceitful than the #Y Austropetolians#!. Most of us favor expelling him, but his fate and that of his people rest with you, my lord."

name: Ok-Opun

name: Ok-Opun
code: helluvian_bible_desc: "A copy of the #T Ullas#!, the sacred text of the #T Helluvian#! faith, once owned by the explorer [GetCharacter('(int32)330').GetName|Y], and given to a benefactor who helped him on his journey to #G Austropetolia#!."

name: Ok-Opun
code:
ularianexplorer_10_desc: "My [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle], there is news of that #Y Ularian#! explorer who departed from our shores with his ships carrying #T Helluvian#! families. You may recall that [GetCharacter('(int32)330').GetName|Y] was determined to find land where his followers could farm and worship their god without interference. It seems a foreign ruler has finally offered them a home!

According to the accounts that have reached [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G], the explorer has accepted a place at court, where his knowledge and the teachings of #T Hellas#! have attracted considerable interest. The families accompanying him have settled in their host's lands, bringing their faith with them, and the man who once went from harbor to harbor asking for assistance now has a home among the people he will serve.

There will be no independent kingdom at the end of this journey, but those who remember his petition may consider this a happier outcome than another uncertain welcome on a distant shore. His people have somewhere to live, their leader has found a useful place in his host's service, and for once there is no need to wonder which ruler might turn them away next."

name: Ok-Opun
code:
ularianexplorer_11_desc: "[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], a curious account from the lands of the #Y Euryalids#! has reached our court. It concerns [GetCharacter('(int32)330').GetName|Y], the #Y Ularian#! who passed beyond our shores in search of a homeland for his #T Helluvian#! followers. Despite the hostility that #Y humans#! might expect to meet in those parts, he has apparently persuaded an #Y Euryalid#! ruler to hear his petition, and the answer was considerably more generous than an order to leave!

Land has been granted to the travelers, and [GetCharacter('(int32)330').GetName|Y] now rules a small realm called #T Etenazun#!. His followers have a place to settle and practice their faith, while their leader has exchanged the uncertainty of his voyage for the responsibilities of a crown. There is, however, a condition attached to this good fortune; the new country must serve the #Y Euryalid#! king as a subject.

Those listening to the report disagree over which ruler has gained the most from the arrangement. Some say that [GetCharacter('(int32)330').GetName|Y] has secured the homeland his followers endured so much to reach, while others observe that the #Y Euryalid#! has acquired a useful servant and new lands under his authority. Whatever the case, the explorer has finally found somewhere to bring his ships ashore."

ularianexplorer_12_desc: "My [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle], there is a tale making its way through [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] that deserves your attention. [GetCharacter('(int32)330').GetName|Y], the #Y Ularian#! who sailed away with his #T Helluvian#! followers, has apparently reached the islands north of #G Acim#! and established a country of his own. Those who remember his little company may be surprised to hear that its captain is now a ruler!

The new realm is called #T Etenazun#!, and its settlement bears the name of [GetProvince('(int32)5600').GetName|G]. Here the families who accompanied him have finally found land on which to make their homes, with [GetCharacter('(int32)330').GetName|Y] himself at their head and the #T Helluvian#! faith established as the religion of their country. For people who left their former homeland to escape persecution, this must seem a considerable improvement upon another uncertain welcome in a foreign harbor.

Of course, a crown does not plant fields or guarantee the safety of an island, and there will be plenty for the new ruler to concern himself with. Still, the explorer who once asked for assistance on his voyage has achieved what he set out to do. Whatever becomes of his little kingdom, its people need no longer search the horizon for somewhere to belong."

name: Ok-Opun
code:
ularianexplorer_12_origin_desc: "You may find this difficult to believe, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], but there is news of the #Y Ularian#! exile whom we allowed to sail away. [GetCharacter('(int32)330').GetName|Y], the #T Helluvian#! nobleman who slipped out of the hands of our authorities, has apparently survived his voyage. Indeed, if the accounts reaching [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] are to be believed, the man has gone considerably further than merely avoiding an executioner's blade!

On the islands north of #G Acim#!, he has founded a realm called #T Etenazun#!, with a settlement that his people call [GetProvince('(int32)5600').GetName|G]. The families who fled our shores have established themselves there under his rule, and the faith that was forbidden to them in our lands is now the religion of their own country. The fugitive nobleman has, in other words, made himself a sovereign.

Some at court dismiss the report as an account of a handful of settlers giving grand names to their new homes. Others remember how confidently it was predicted that the explorer would meet his end at the hands of a foreign despot. Whatever opinion your majesty holds of the matter, it would seem that the fool we sent away has found his homeland after all."

name: Ok-Opun
code: ularianexplorer_13_title: "The Last Audience of [GetCharacter('(int32)330').GetName]"

name: Ok-Opun
code:
ularianexplorer_13_desc: "My [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle], word has reached [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] concerning [GetCharacter('(int32)330').GetName|Y], the #Y Ularian#! who departed with his #T Helluvian#! followers in search of a new homeland. Unfortunately, the news brings an end to any speculation about how far his ships might carry him. The explorer has been executed at one of the foreign courts along his route.

It seems that his request for assistance earned him neither provisions nor permission to settle, but a sentence of death. The man who had hoped to find a ruler sympathetic to his people's plight instead found one unwilling to allow him to leave alive. For all his determination, there was little that an account of distant lands or an appeal on behalf of his companions could do to save him.

What happened to the families aboard his ships is less certain. No reliable account of their fate has reached our court, and those repeating the news cannot tell us whether they remained there or sought refuge elsewhere. We know only that their captain will lead them no farther, and that the homeland he promised to find will not be founded by his hand."

name: Ok-Opun
code:
ularianexplorer_14_desc: "[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], there is unfortunate news concerning the #Y Ularian#! explorer who passed beyond our shores. We have received word that [GetCharacter('(int32)330').GetName|Y] has died before completing his search for a homeland. The accounts reaching [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] agree on his death, though they offer little that we can say with confidence about the circumstances.

You may remember that his ships carried families who had left their former country in the hope of practicing the #T Helluvian#! faith in peace. It was an ambitious undertaking for such a company, dependent upon finding both a place to settle and rulers willing to let them reach it. With their leader gone, we can no longer say where that journey might take them.

There are already those at court willing to supply the missing details, as there always are when news arrives from distant shores. Until a more reliable account reaches us, however, it would be unwise to repeat their stories as fact. What became of the explorer's companions remains unknown; for now, all that we can record is that [GetCharacter('(int32)330').GetName|Y] did not live to found the homeland he sought."

name: Ok-Opun
code:
ularianexplorer_15_desc: "My [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle], word has reached [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName|G] of the #Y Ularian#! explorer who sailed away with his #T Helluvian#! followers. [GetCharacter('(int32)330').GetName|Y] has found a ruler willing to grant his people land, though there is an obligation attached to the gift!

The government of [SCOPE.sCountry('ularian_settlement_overlord').GetName|T] has granted him a single settlement, now called [SCOPE.sProvince('ularian_subject_settlement').GetName|G]. Here he rules [SCOPE.sCountry('ularian_opm_subject').GetName|T], a small #Y Ularian#! realm whose people may follow the #T Helluvian#! faith under his leadership. In return, the new ruler owes allegiance and service to the country that made his settlement possible.

It is a modest beginning for a man who set out to find a homeland, and some at court wonder whether he has traded the uncertainty of the sea for dependence upon another sovereign. Still, his followers have somewhere to make their homes, and the ruler who granted them refuge has gained a subject. Whatever the future holds for their little realm, their search for a place to settle has ended."

name: Ok-Opun
code:
ularianexplorer_16_desc: "My [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle], the grant has been made. [GetCharacter('(int32)330').GetName|Y] now rules [SCOPE.sCountry('ularian_opm_subject').GetName|T] from [SCOPE.sProvince('ularian_subject_settlement').GetName|G], and his little realm stands under our protection as a feudatory. The settlement is his to govern, while its ruler owes us allegiance and service.

Two #Y Ularian#! #T Helluvian#! families have settled there as freemen, and those local inhabitants who have accepted their faith will worship alongside them. Our new subject has been provided with funds and manpower to begin establishing itself, though a single settlement leaves its ruler plenty of work to do.

For the explorer, at least, there is relief in knowing where his voyage has brought him. There will be no further petition at another foreign harbor; his people have found a home, and we have gained a new subject."

name: Ok-Opun
code: ularianexplorer_17_desc: "My [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle], the proposed settlement at [SCOPE.sProvince('ularian_subject_settlement').GetName] has yet to become the promised realm under [GetCharacter('(int32)330').GetName]. Until his rule is established there, our promise of a homeland remains unfulfilled."

name: Ok-Opun
code: ularianexplorer_18_desc: "My [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle], [GetCharacter('(int32)330').GetName] now rules the independent realm of [SCOPE.sCountry('ularian_state').GetName] from [GetProvince('(int32)5600').GetName]. The travelers have brought their long search for a homeland to an end, and the Ularian settlers have begun a new life under a ruler of their own.\n\nTheir Helluvian faith is now the religion of their country, and the settlement has been provided with funds and manpower for the work ahead. It is a small beginning, but for the families who left their former homes in search of refuge, there is finally somewhere to build a future."

name: Haajara
code:
startup_events.1.desc:2 "Eighteen years ago the Argead King [GetCharacter('(int32)39').GetPraenomen] III died suddenly in [GetProvince('(int32)918').GetName] at the age of thirty-two. In the five years preceding his death, his continuing military successes had reshaped the world as known to the Greeks; his empire stretching, uninterrupted, from Egypt to the Indus.

The suddenness of [GetCharacter('(int32)39').GetPraenomen]'s early death, and his lack of a chosen successor, sent shockwaves through the hierarchy of satraps and generals who attended him, splintering his empire into elements ruled by these potentates, styled as the 'Diadochi'.

For many years, they and their successors have been locked in a bitter struggle over the future of the empire, drawing all nations within their sphere of influence into the conflict. The wars of the Diadochi will surely continue; perhaps it is up to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] Kingdom to decide how they will end."

name: Condarillus
code:
startup_events.2.desc:1 "An ancient and proud civilization, [GetCountry('CAR').GetName] holds a firm grip on the southern coast of the Mediterranean. Numerous colonial dependencies lie in thrall to the maritime giant, dotted along the coast of Iberia and islands throughout the western parts of the sea.

The seafaring heritage of the [GetCountry('CAR').GetAdjective]s remains unparalleled, extending territorial and economic dominance far and wide, however, the island of Sicily has remained a constant thorn in the side of the [GetCountry('CAR').GetAdjective] hegemony for many decades.

[GetCharacter('(int32)56').GetPraenomen], the self-styled Tyrant of [GetCountry('SYR').GetName], still reigns in the eastern part of the island, having secured a tentative peace with [GetCountry('CAR').GetName], prolonging Greek presence there, for the time being. Further north, the young and uncivilized Italic states wage bitter war on one another, though there are rumors that a once-insignificant city is emerging to challenge the balance of power in Italy. They call themselves [GetCountry('ROM').GetName]."

name: Haajara
code: diadochi_flavor.6.desc:2 "The kings that once served [GetCharacter('(int32)39').GetPraenomen] have started to pass away, and with them so does the immediate claim to his empire. The men who have become known as 'the Successors' are now themselves being succeeded by their progeny, the 'Epigoni'.\n\nWhile powerful leaders in their own right, with a strong claim to the realms of their fathers, these 'Epigoni' are regional dynasts, and cannot restore an empire that has been tainted by a generation of infighting."

name: Haajara
code: diadochi_flavor.7.desc:1 "As the successor of [GetCharacter('(int32)39').GetPraenomen]'s empire, we must consider if [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName] is really the best place from which to rule the Hellenistic world. Some would argue that there are other cities that would be better suited for such a task.\n\nOf course every possible location would come with its own benefits, so such a choice would have to be made carefully."

name: Zanis
code: diadochi_flavor.8.desc:3 "With his passing, the state that [GetCharacter('(int32)37').GetPraenomen] built out of his Phrygian satrapy stands, for the first time, without its founder. His meteoric rise once attracted the envy and admiration of a generation, but the arrayed enmity of the other Diadochi tested the old general to the limit.\n\nLoyalty among our Asian subjects and their Macedonian administrators is wavering, and myriad provinces are already welcoming our enemies, driving the others dangerously close to defecting from our authority. We must decide whether to attempt to keep hold of what remains of [GetCharacter('(int32)37').GetPraenomen]' eastern core together, or risk the fate of our dynasty on connections with the Greeks in the west."

code: diadochi_flavor.23.desc:2 "In a shock turn of events, the [GetCountry('PRY').GetAdjective]s appear to be too preoccupied with [GetProvince('(int32)418').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName], to be able to refuse our outrageous demands.\n\nTheir envoy reluctantly agrees to cede territory in [GetProvince('(int32)687').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName] and [GetProvince('(int32)790').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName], in return for a truce, while their armies are engaged combating the insidious [GetCharacter('(int32)32').GetName] and his kin."

name: Rhuzemes
code:
razani_civil_war_1_desc: "It's been around a year since the emperor has left his palace or addressed his people.

Time has not been kind to the elderly emperor, nor has it healed his broken heart. He wanders the halls endlessly, occasionally opening a door as if he would find his beloved inside. Instead, all he finds are lifeless chambers and memories of better days. Days of glory, of conquest, where he ruled the known world alongside his love.

Now his days pass without meaning, occasionally interrupted by his son, the only one he allows to see him. However, as their meetings shorten, so does the old man's time, and all the frail emperor can do is lie and dream of better days...

However, #E Wisheamu Wachumagel#! pities no man, and the various nobles of the realm are aware that the aging [GetCharacter('(int32)228').GetName] needs an official heir, lest the weakened empire fall apart. Those who know him throw their support behind the skilled #E [GetCharacter('(int32)229').GetFirstName]#!, as they trust his administrative skills and clever mind. While these qualities would make for an excellent scholar, there is more to ruling than paperwork. A poor general and an even worse orator, #E [GetCharacter('(int32)229').GetFirstName]#! inspires little loyalty amongst his troops or influential nobles. With the #E Helluvian#! threat continuing to cause trouble in the south, there are many inside the #E Blue Marble Palace#! that hesitate to support his rule publicly. Worse, the #E Imperial Council#! remains silent on whether they approve of his succession. Although the young prince carries #E Zanic#! blood, his poor military reputation leaves many traditional council members unwilling to support his accession.

A relentless planner, #E [GetCharacter('(int32)229').GetFirstName]#! knows that he would not be able to legitimately take the throne in his current position. Without full support from either the army or the #E Imperial Council#! it is more likely he would face exile than become #E Shanuzushanuz#!. Although the odds seemed to have stacked against him, he does have one final chance at securing enough support to possibly ensure his ascension to the throne: an explicit appointment as heir by the emperor himself. Such a powerful move typically reserved only for emergencies would bypass the kingmaking power of both the #E Imperial Council#! and the #E Gonessionem#!, making it the only way forward.

As the young man sat down to converse with the dying emperor, he lamented the condition his father was in.

Pale and prone to coughing fits, the emperor could barely muster enough strength to sit up and face his son. Without a word, the emperor nodded, acquiescing to the young man's demands, aware of what he was there for, and accepted his fate. #E #R Renn#!#! would soon come for him, and he knew he could not protect the boy forever.

With his imperial stamp of approval, the young prince was now heir apparent to the great #E Eastern Empire of the Zani#!.

As the news spread across the empire many celebrated the stability an official heir would bring, others still breathed a sigh of relief that their empire would not die alongside the old emperor.

However, there were those who did not share these sentiments.

Out of the four #E Gonessionem#! remaining, two have not expressed support for the heir apparent. [GetCharacter('(int32)125').GetName], hero of the #E Battle of Gesma#! continued to enjoy widespread popular across the empire even after his appointment to the far west. #E [GetCharacter('(int32)229').GetFirstName]'s#! opponents on both the #E Imperial Council#! and the #E XV Intermarenica#! still remember his ambitious bid for the throne, and many of them were part of the advisory group that convinced Shanuzushanuz #E [GetCharacter('(int32)228').GetFirstName]#! to pardon the young general. Rumors say his ambitions haven't been satiated, and he's currently biding his time until the elderly emperor passes on to make his play for the throne.

As the weeks pass, officials speak in hushed tones of the council's support for the young #E Uzani#! general play for the throne. Perhaps it is just hearsay, but rumors that pass through the walls of the #E Blue Marble Palace#! are hardly ever pure fabrications..."

code:
razani_civil_war_1_desc: "It's been around a year since the emperor has left his palace or addressed his people.

Time has not been kind to the elderly emperor, nor has it healed his broken heart. He wanders the halls endlessly, occasionally opening a door as if he would find his beloved inside. Instead, all he finds are lifeless chambers and memories of better days. Days of glory, of conquest, where he ruled the known world alongside his love.

Now his days pass without meaning, occasionally interrupted by his son, the only one he allows to see him. However, as their meetings shorten, so does the old man's time, and all the frail emperor can do is lie and dream of better days...

However, #E Wisheamu Wachumagel#! pities no man, and the various nobles of the realm are aware that the aging [GetCharacter('(int32)228').GetName] needs an official heir, lest the weakened empire fall apart. Those who know him throw their support behind the skilled #E [GetCharacter('(int32)229').GetFirstName]#!, as they trust his administrative skills and clever mind. While these qualities would make for an excellent scholar, there is more to ruling than paperwork. A poor general and an even worse orator, #E [GetCharacter('(int32)229').GetFirstName]#! inspires little loyalty amongst his troops or influential nobles. With the #E Helluvian#! threat continuing to cause trouble in the south, there are many inside the #E Blue Marble Palace#! that hesitate to support his rule publicly. Worse, the #E Imperial Council#! remains silent on whether they approve of his succession. Although the young prince carries #E Zanic#! blood, his poor military reputation leaves many traditional council members unwilling to support his accession.

A relentless planner, #E [GetCharacter('(int32)229').GetFirstName]#! knows that he would not be able to legitimately take the throne in his current position. Without full support from either the army or the #E Imperial Council#! it is more likely he would face exile than become #E Shanuzushanuz#!. Although the odds seemed to have stacked against him, he does have one final chance at securing enough support to possibly ensure his ascension to the throne: an explicit appointment as heir by the emperor himself. Such a powerful move typically reserved only for emergencies would bypass the kingmaking power of both the #E Imperial Council#! and the #E Gonessionem#!, making it the only way forward.

As the young man sat down to converse with the dying emperor, he lamented the condition his father was in.

Pale and prone to coughing fits, the emperor could barely muster enough strength to sit up and face his son. Without a word, the emperor nodded, acquiescing to the young man's demands, aware of what he was there for, and accepted his fate. #E #R Renn#!#! would soon come for him, and he knew he could not protect the boy forever.

With his imperial stamp of approval, the young prince was now heir apparent to the great #E Eastern Empire of the Zani#!.

As the news spread across the empire many celebrated the stability an official heir would bring, others still breathed a sigh of relief that their empire would not die alongside the old emperor.

However, there were those who did not share these sentiments.

Out of the four #E Gonessionem#! remaining, two have not expressed support for the heir apparent. [GetCharacter('(int32)125').GetName], hero of the #E Battle of Gesma#! continued to enjoy widespread popular across the empire even after his appointment to the far west. #E [GetCharacter('(int32)229').GetFirstName]'s#! opponents on both the #E Imperial Council#! and the #E XV Intermarenica#! still remember his ambitious bid for the throne, and many of them were part of the advisory group that convinced Shanuzushanuz #E [GetCharacter('(int32)228').GetFirstName]#! to pardon the young general. Rumors say his ambitions haven't been satiated, and he's currently biding his time until the elderly emperor passes on to make his play for the throne.

As the weeks pass, officials speak in hushed tones of the council's support for the young #E Uzani#! general play for the throne. Perhaps it is just hearsay, but rumors that pass through the walls of the #E Blue Marble Palace#! are hardly ever pure fabrications..."

name: Rhuzemes
code:
razani_civil_war_2_desc: "The time has come.

The old man looks in the corner to see the shadowy figure of #E #R Renn#!#! approaching him. The blue-skinned god approaches him, and as he gets closer, [GetCharacter('(int32)228').GetName] can see him more clearly.

The death god has taken the form of a tall, bald man, his pitch black eyes stare at [GetCharacter('(int32)228').GetName] with an emotionless expression impossible to read.

'Rise, #E Rhuzemes#!.'

The emperor gets out of bed without difficulty. The old man feels stronger, taller, younger. He turns to look at his bedside mirror, and is frozen in shock as he gazes upon the face of his younger self.

Smiling, the emperor asks the god:

'Is my beloved amongst the chosen?'

The stoic god does not react, and simply responds

'Yes'

The young #E Rhuzemes#!, elated, asks the god:

'Take me to her.'

#E #R Renn#!#! nods, and walks toward the entrance of the room. There, he opens the door to reveal Elysium. Inside, happy faces feast, sing songs, and dance. #E Rhuzemes#! sees great emperors of old, heroes of legend, and even [GetCharacter('(int32)168').GetName] himself.

The former emperor follows the death god to the entrance but stops before entering the door. #E Rhuzemes#! backs away from the door slowly, much to the confusion of the great #E #R Renn#!#!. The world of the living still beckoning to him, he asks the god:

'What of my son? Will he become an emperor worthy of #E Zanis#!' legacy?'

The silent god once again does not react. He stares at #E Rhuzemes#! in silence. The former emperor sees his brow furrow.

'Will my son be safe?'

The great god ruminates for a moment.

'He will find his way to Elysium, great king.'

With his fears assauged, the young man hesitantly walks back towards the door. Before stepping in, however, he turns, as if hoping to see his child one last time. Met with silence, the emperor takes a deep breath, and walks through the door."

razani_civil_war_3_desc: "Important news from the heirs of the #E Zani#! have reached #E [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]'s#! court!

The sickly emperor [GetCharacter('(int32)228').GetName] has died, creating a succession crisis between the appointed heir [GetCharacter('(int32)229').GetName] and the great general [GetCharacter('(int32)125').GetName]!

Ruling from [GetProvince('(int32)2478').GetName], #E [GetCharacter('(int32)229').GetFirstName]#! enjoys the legitimacy that comes from the official appointment as heir from the previous emperor. However, this son is an awkward and cowardly man, hardly someone able firmly grip the reins of a struggling empire.

Opposing him, the proud #E [GetCharacter('(int32)125').GetFirstName]#! was the general that defeated #E Jarenam the Formidable#!'s forces at the #E Battle of Gesma#!. Needless to say, such a feat has made him a popular figure amongst the #E Gonessionem#!, with most of them supporting him as the new Emperor.

Despite who wins, such a large civil war after years of external and internal strife is sure to devastate the weary #E Geallians#!, once the masters of #E Omniluxia#!."

name: O-Bantenn
code:
razani_civil_war_4_desc: "Great Shanuzushanuz, important news comes from the east!

The [GetCountry('EGA').GetName] has fallen into a civil war between the two claimants to the #E Eastern Throne#!, [GetCharacter('(int32)229').GetName] and [GetCharacter('(int32)125').GetName].

[GetCharacter('(int32)125').GetName] is a respected general responsible for the #E Razani#! victory at the #E Battle of Gesma#!, however, [GetCharacter('(int32)229').GetName] was appointed by the previous emperor, [GetCharacter('(int32)228').GetName], as the heir to the #E Razani#! throne.

Despite this war being fought far from our shores, it would behoove your highness to take interest in this conflict, as friendly relations with the victor could entail cooperation with the east against the upstart [GetCountry('JRE').GetName] and [GetCountry('EGY').GetName]. Should the rumors be true, the new Emperor is a weak, awkward man who would be easier to manipulate than the proud [GetCharacter('(int32)125').GetName]. Should we support him, he may be more favorable towards us in future conflicts and negotiations.

That being said, there is a sizable faction at court that would like to see the great #E Purple Emperor#! unite both the east and the west. However, with such a distance between the two empires, the possible cost of occupying large tracts of far-off eastern lands may be too expensive for us to handle. Nevertheless, such an opportunity should not be dismissed without being given proper consideration. Should such a plan work, we may be able to finally reunify the #E Geallians#! and reform the #E Zani Empire#!!

Whatever choice the #E Purple Emperor#! makes, it is sure to be an expensive endeavor, and the best choice might just be to allow the east to solve its own issues."

razani_civil_war_6_desc: "Noble Shanuzushanuz, some good news has arrived at court! Our brothers from the west, the [GetCountry('WGA').GetName], have sent us aid against our common enemy!

The magnanimous #E Purple Emperor#! has decided to support the legitimate claimant of the throne in our war against the upstart [GetCharacter('(int32)229').GetName].

Their help came at a crucial time, as many of our subjects who once questioned your legitimacy now recognize you as the rightful emperor of the #E Razani#!.

Should we win this war, we should strive to cooperate more with the #E Western Emperor#! to reciprocate his kindness."

name: Tetem
code:
razani_civil_war_7_desc: "My King, troubling news from the capital!

While you've been on campaign against the #E Uzani#! pretender, your brother, [GetCharacter('(int32)126').GetName], has crowned himself king by his Helluvian supporters near [GetProvince('(int32)3337').GetName] and declared a holy war for the throne! Reports indicate that his army now marches towards [GetProvince('(int32)3399').GetName] intending to gather more support along the way.

Such a tragedy must have been the result of the Helluvian plague that infected the mind of the young prince at an early age. By your majesty's generosity alone he was allowed to continue to practice his faith in secret, protected from the prying eyes of Razani inquisitors, as your father would have wanted. The same man would now weep at seeing his only sons fight each other in a fatal struggle over the throne.

Due to his history as a dependable general loyal to the crown, it is clear to the court who has been manipulated by the Helluvian dissidents of the eastern hills. While #E [GetCharacter('(int32)126').GetFirstName]#! publicly portrays himself as a liberator who intends to free #E Ytalia#! from #E Razani#! chains, his supporters secretly claim he will place the glory of Hellas atop the false gods of #E Zanis Zani#! to win the support of the growing Helluvian population of our nation! 

The more we hear of the Helluvian superstition that infects our nation, the more our court is convinced that the young upstart must be made an example of. As both a sacrilegist and a traitor, there are more than enough reasons to imprison and execute #E [GetCharacter('(int32)126').GetFirstName]#! before his movement can gain enough momentum to truly threaten your throne! We will not allow the Helluvian vultures to divide our nation and take the minds of our brothers and sisters!"

name: O-Yatonn
code:
razani_civil_war_8_desc: "Magnanimous Shanuzushauz, urgent news arrives from the south! It appears that the two brothers of the wise king [GetCharacter('(int32)83').GetName] are at war over the throne of [GetCountry('YGA').GetName]!

While our subject, King #E [GetCharacter('(int32)127').GetFirstName]#! was fighting with us against the pretender #E Dobpunn#!, his brother, #E [GetCharacter('(int32)126').GetFirstName]#!, has raised an army of his supporters in [GetProvince('(int32)3337').GetName] and now marches on [GetProvince('(int32)3399').GetName]!

A devout #E #R Helluvian#!#!, #E [GetCharacter('(int32)126').GetFirstName]#! claims #E Hellas#! has ordained him as the true king of a free #E Ytalia#!, and he vows to enforce his dangerous superstitions on the loyal citizens of #E Ytalia#!. He has refused any offers at peace, and has stated he will not end his crusade until his people are no longer 'heathens' or vassals of our great empire. With enough unrest brewing due to the ongoing civil war, such flagrent heresy and disobedience must not be allowed to spread!

If we decide to commit to defending our #E Lisintheon#! we must do so quickly before the heretical pretender is able to take control of the #E Ytalian#! throne!"

name: O-Dzuzpun
code:
razani_civil_war_9_desc: "Great Emperor, alarming news from the #E Gevannia Vadatheon#! has just arrived!

Reports indicate that the son of the rebellious [GetCharacter('(int32)129').GetName] is leading an uprising against the [GetProvince('(int32)2470').GetName] elites, recruiting men from both the local aristocracy and the lower classes across #E Gevannia#! to join their cause.

If you can recall, #E [GetCharacter('(int32)129').GetFirstName]#! was the man who inspired rebellion against governor [GetCharacter('(int32)230').GetName] a few years ago, and was arrested for high treason against the state. name: O-Sarzen
code:
razani_civil_war_15_desc: "Wise Shanuzushanuz, it seems that the erratic Esemamshauza #E [GetCharacter('(int32)234').GetFirstName]#! of the #E Adanvem Vadatheon#! has risen in revolt against our rule!

A scholar at heart, when #E [GetCharacter('(int32)234').GetFirstName]#! took over as Esemamshauza it was hoped by many in the imperial court that he would be more competent than his impulsive father. While [GetCharacter('(int32)234').GetSheHe] did succeed in optimizing the bureaucracy of the #E Vadatheon#!, [GetCharacter('(int32)234').GetHerHis] obsession with the people of the former city of [GetProvince('(int32)2519').GetName] got him into some trouble with imperial authorities.

Ancestors of the modern #E Gunstris#! people, the #E Kunnstri#! were an #E Illorian#! people who served as auxiliaries and administrators of western #E Intermarenica#! from their capital at [GetProvince('(int32)2519').GetName] under the emperors of the #E Zani Empire#! in exchange for a special status similar to the one enjoyed by the #E Ytalians#!. However, as a part of the consolidation of #E Razani#! rule over the east following the #E Great Collapse#! the #E Kunnstri#! lost many of their privileges and were pushed to assimilate like many other #E Illorian#! cities, pushing them to lead the #E Great Intermarenican Revolt#! of 707 LC. When the #E Kunnstri#! were reconquered by the #E Razani#! alongside the rest of western and central #E Intermarenica#! in the early 800s their city was razed and their history was erased in an attempt to punish them for their treason. #E Kor-Kunnstis#! was renamed, and political power in what became the province of #E Adanvem#! shifted to the coast and plains that neighbored the hilly homelands of the #E Kunnstri#!.

Although the #E Kunnstri#! were forcibly assimilated into #E Geallian#! society, there are still #E Gunstris#! scholars and elders that preserve the ancient histories of their people. It must be these ancient texts alongside the ongoing civil war that inspired the foolish #E [GetCharacter('(int32)234').GetFirstName]#! to restore this long-dead kingdom. 

Regardless of his motivations, it is doubtful that his rebellion has much popular support, as few loyal #E Zanic#! subjects believe their ancestors belonged an ancient Illorian kingdom, and fewer still would care about the pride of a people that died centuries ago. We must act quickly and defeat this book-nosed lunatic before his rebellious sentiments spread!"

name: Etedunn
code:
razani_civil_war_16_desc: "Great Shanuzushanuz, concerning news comes to us from the lands of the #E Shawuante Vadatheon#!!

The boisterous Esemamshauza #E [GetCharacter('(int32)235').GetFirstName]#! has finally lost his mind! News has arrived from fleeing refugees that the Esemamshauza's sizable ego was seduced by a local cult that proclaimed him the prophesized 'Son of Wishtheon', a title that can be traced back to the great #E Zanis Zani#!, the gall of the miscreant to accept such a sacred title!

According to local legend, the native #E Shwi#!, the tribes of the #E Desert of Orange Sands#!, served as the elite horsemen of the great #E Zanis Zani#! after he was able to speak to their god #E Wishtheon#! through a boulder that carried the sleeping god's spirit, known as the #E Stone of Wishtheon#!. It is said that upon touching the boulder, the rock shone so brightly it momentarily blinded all but the #E Great Conqueror#! himself, and when the local shamans opened their eyes they saw a brilliant light surrounding the #E Weshuchachoam#!, the #E Chosen One#!. It was amongst the #E Shwi#! that the father of the #E Zani#! received his quest to venture west, conquering all of the known world along the way. 

The #E Shwi#! followed the great conqueror, hoping to find the endless fertile fields of #E Shisumache#! fortold to be at the end of the chosen one's journey. Alas, neither they nor the legendary emperor made it to the end of the world, leaving the #E Shwi#! to await for a new prophesized one.

It appears that they have found their new chosen one in the form of #E [GetCharacter('(int32)235').GetFirstName]#!. Whether he actually spoke to the stone or #E Shwi#! chiefs intend to capitalize on the chaos caused by the ongoing civil war to usurp power, our court can only speculate. What is certain are the reports of the former Esemamshauza leading armies of desert horsemen west in an inferior attempt to imitate the great #E Zanis Zani#!.

We must stop him before his armies arrive at the gates of [GetProvince('(int32)2478').GetName]!"

name: Ok-Uunn
code:
razani_civil_war_17_desc: "Wise Shanuzushanuz, urgent news from the center of our empire!

It appears that the local #E Enenten#! nobility of the #E Enente Vadatheon#! have risen up against our rule and executed the noble Esemamshauza #E [GetCharacter('(int32)233').GetFirstName]#!! Reports indicate that they have formed an assembly similar to the #E Imperial Council#! that they are calling a #E Manmiz#!, where they have declared themselves an independent republic. Claiming to defend the interests of the #E Enenten#! people, the small citizen army of the republic now marches against us!

The native elites of the divided #E Enenten#! people are usually apathetic to the affairs of the empire, and prefer to relax on their isolated plantations enjoying lavish lifestyles and expensive goods. Although it is not clear why they revolted, many suspect that there was a deeper reason beyond the complaints made against the former Esemamshauza #E [GetCharacter('(int32)233').GetFirstName]#!. Perhaps the treacherous agents of #E Zorgolis#! are at work?

Regardless of their motives, it is clear that we must put down this fledgling democratic movement before it continues to spread across the empire, lest we face even more insurrections."

name: Renze
code:
razani_civil_war_18_desc: "Great Shanuzushanuz, shocking news has arrived from the edges of the empire!

The deplorable traitor #E [GetCharacter('(int32)232').GetFirstName]#! has declared himself the sole king of the former #E Gashanytalia Vadatheon#!! The former Esemamshauza of the Vadatheon, the court has long kept a suspicious eye on the governor due to his unscrupulous reputation. Both the invasions of #E Jarenam the Formidable Dragon#! and the entrenchment of the #E Buzani#! family in the region kept #E [GetCharacter('(int32)232').GetFirstName]#! safe from imperial action until now, as the court could only hope that he was content with governorship of an entire province.

Unfortunately, it seems that hope is a fickle thing to rely on, and, true to his nature, #E [GetCharacter('(int32)232').GetFirstName]#! now seeks to carve out a kingdom of his own under the guise of 'freeing' the people of #E Ytalia#! from our 'oppressive' rule. Luckily for us, his words ring hollow with many local elites who still support us.

We must act quickly before #E [GetCharacter('(int32)232').GetFirstName]#! is able to quash our supporters in the region and expand his fabricated kingdom at the expense of our battered empire!"

name: Gerodd
code:
03_duggmannrum_DESCRIPTION: "The great kingdom of [GetCountry('SV3').GetName] is in mourning, as the wise king #E [GetCharacter('(int32)76').GetFirstName]#! now rests with his ancestors in the great #E Silver Caves#!. His extensive rule oversaw the slow conquest and integration of the lands surrounding [GetProvince('(int32)3883')GetName|E], finally reuniting the former lands of the historic principality of #E Duggmannri#!, creating a new power in the #E Green Valley#!. With its large population and historical significance as the core of the #E Second Kingdom of Srrørum#!, most in the valley expected the kingdom to make a bid for reunification.

It was this fear that drove the other nations to form coalition after coalition to try and stifle the potential of this rising rival. Instead of retaliating, the wise  #E [GetCharacter('(int32)76').GetFirstName]#! spent the rest of his reign devoted to making diplomatic connections and defending his territory, slowly building up his kingdom and reputation. Near the end of his rule, the former members of the latest coalition, exhausted from years of war, signed the great #E Eternal Peace#! meant to end all hostilities in the valley. While there continues to be raids and skirmishes along isolated borders, the effectiveness of this treaty has stood as perhaps the greatest accomplishment of the former king.

On his deathbed, the old royal called for his only son, #E [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]#!. Nobody knows what was said in that room, but what emerged from the King's chamber was not the scared young prince that had entered. His visage now resembled that of a man determined to follow a king's dying wish.

Once crowned, #E [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]#! made his intentions clear to the court: he alone would be the one to unite the #E Anvindr#! under his banner.
"

name: Hartbaltt
code:
me_duggmannrum_1_desc: "It has been over a year since the death of the former king, yet #E [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! still remembers his final conversation with his late father:

'#Y My son, I have done all I can for you. My time approaches soon.#!'

Tears ran down the young prince's cheeks. The old man was so frail his words could be mistaken for mumbled whispers.

'#G I'm not ready father. I would be lost without your guidance.#!'

#E [GetCharacter('(int32)76').GetFirstName]#! looked over at his son. Although even the young man himself saw a terrified boy not ready for the responsibilities of a king, the shrewd old man saw what he could become.

'#Y Foolish boy, are you not the scholar you claim to be? All the guidance you need has been preserved in the tomes written by your ancestors.#!'

#E [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! wiped his eyes and chuckled. No matter how old he grew his father would still scold him as if he were a child.

'#G Is that why you were always so fixated on conquering #E Veddtunn#!#!?'

The old man paused, lost in thought. Puzzled,  #E [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! studied his father's face as it made an expression he had never seen before. After a moment of contemplation, #E [GetCharacter('(int32)76').GetFirstName]#! spoke:

'#Y #E Veddtunn#! holds the key my son. The key to reunifying the valley.#!'

'#G How so? There aren't many military manuals we don't already possess here-#!'

'#Y Deep within the secret rooms of the ancient tower resides a record, one that may grant you the legitimacy you need to rule it all...#!'

'#G Rule it all? Father, if you couldn't do it what makes you think-#!'

#E [GetCharacter('(int32)76').GetFirstName]#! raised his hand to silence his son's protests. After a brief pause, the old man uttered his final words.

'#Y Go to #E Veddtunn#! and reclaim your birthright. Use the gifts I have left you to reconquer the Silver Kingdom, and go beyond the Western Door. This I ask of you, because I know only you can do it.#!'

...

Although its been kept a strict secret to not arouse suspicion, everyone at court knows what #E [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]'s#! ambitions are. With excellent information on his enemies and his nation ready to march alongside him, it is time for the entire #E Green Valley#! to learn what kind of king #E [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! intends to be."

code:
me_duggmannrum_2_desc: "The same scene repeats in every nation.

Displays of outrage, disbelief, and panic were soon replaced with a concealed smile that revealed their true colors. In truth, the rulers of the six nations did not wait for this day with baited breaths, but with wanton anticipation. Every nation had unresolved conflicts and grudges, some dating back centuries, that they intended to settle on the battlefield. me_duggmannrum_5_desc: "When a messenger arrived asking for an audience with #E [GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetFirstName]#! with on behalf of the young king of [GetCountry('SV3').GetName], the #E Srrøbondi#! was hesitant to accept his request. This was the same belligerent man who had trampled what peace there was in the valley with his volatile actions.

#E [GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetFirstName]#! agrees to the meeting, and sends the messenger back to his king with the good news. Whatever #E [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]'s#! motives may be, this meeting would serve as an excellent opportunity for the ambitious #E Srrøbondi#! to finally get involved in the politics of the #E Green Valley#!. Having sworn themselves to the defense of the #E Silver Caves#! and the #E Duggmoggen Clan#!, the knights of the #E Order of Sennmoggen#! consider involving themselves in the affairs of other nations a taboo ever since the death of their patron and the final #E Duggmoggen#!, King #E Hefdarr#!. If #E [GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetFirstName]#! can persuade the other senior members of the order that #E [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! poses a significant threat to the sacred #E Silver Caves#!, he might be able to mobilize the knights to carve out his own kingdom.

#E [GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetFirstName]'s#! eyebrows furrow, what was the young king doing?

He was expecting a boisterous tyrant who would demand the knights submit to him, not the relatively soft-spoken young man kneeling in front of him. Kneeling in front of the leader of another nation? Whatever his aims were, #E [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! had certainly captured the attention of the #E Srrøbondi#!. The knight let out a hearty laugh.

'#Y Hail fellow, it is good to meet you young #E [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#!! Whatever it is you're here for I guarantee you won't find it on your knees.#!'

Muffled snickers and whispers surrounded the chamber. The young king, however, looked unphased.

'#G I came looking for a sword.#!'

'#Y A sword?#!'

'#G Yes, every great King needs a sword to both protect him and attack his enemies. I am told that you and your knights are the finest warriors in the valley, and so I came to ask you to be my sword.#!'

#E [GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetFirstName]#! scoffs. What a ridiculous request! Is this just the enigmatic man's way of asking his order to submit to his nation?

'#Y Humor me, o great king. Why should we?#!'

#E [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! looked around the room. It was not yet time.

'#Y Perhaps I may convince you over dinner?#!'

Amused, the #E Srrøbondi#! chuckled.

#G Of course, you must be weary from your journey after all. I assure you we have enough chairs that you need not kneel for this meal.#!'

...

Later that night, long after the merriment and laughs that accompanied tonight's meal, the two men conversed alone in the #E Srrøbondi's#! office.

'#G Thank you again for the meal, Srrøbondi#!'

'#Y Please, call me #E [GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetFirstName]#!. I should be the one thanking you for being an excellent guest. I much enjoyed the stories about your time in [GetProvince('(int32)3947')GetName|E]#!'

'#G The only thing those merchants love more than coins is beer, I can guarantee you that!#!'

The two men shared a laugh, which #E [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! soon followed with a question:

'#G Have you thought of my request?#!'

A brief look of confusion flashed across #E [GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetFirstName]'s#! face, followed by one of recognition.

'#Y Young King, I believe you have yet to convince me to give up our sovereignty#!'

#E [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! frowned,

'#G It's not an annexation if that's what you thought I was offering. It'd be more akin to an alliance. You lend me you armies and I protect you lands from the western nations.#!'

'#Y What would we have to gain from an alliance with you? You're reputation would suggest you don't do well with treaties#!'

#E [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! winced. The #E Srrøbondi#! wasn't wrong. It seemed that the only way to convince him would be appeal to the Order's oaths. The King called in one of his servants and brought out a large red book, presenting it to #E [GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetFirstName]#!.

'#Y What is this?#!'

'#G An argument, for the alliance#!'

Confused, #E [GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetFirstName]#! opened the book, and began to read."

code:
me_duggmannrum_9_desc: "Fulfilling his dying father's wish, young #E [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetName]#! has finally taken the ancient library of #E Veddtunn#!!

Said to contain information on nearly every topic known to the #E Silver Dwarves#!, the tower itself hides many secret tombs from curious scholars within its labyrinthian corridors and chambers. So vast is the library and its catacombs that it is not uncommon to hear stories of new chambers being rediscovered with the bones of long-dead scribes.

Accompanied by a retinue of his loyal guard and with only a small note left by his father to guide him, #E [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetName]#! begins his descent into the catacombs in search of the ancient treasure that is the key to the unification of the #E Green Valley#!."

name: Gerrheltt
code:
me_duggmannrum_27_desc: "Looking over his prosperous realm, King [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName] is finally prepared to announce the restoration of an ancient legacy. He holds a grand celebration in his capital that lasts five days, culminating in a coronation ceremony in his new palace at [GetProvince('(int32)3883').GetName]. However, before [GetCharacter('(int32)78').GetName] can place the crown atop his head, the King motions for him to give him the crown, which he takes and holds above his head. As the crowd murmurs, he proclaims:

'When I donn on this crown I cast off my previous identity as [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName] and claim my true heritage:'

'I am #E Hefdarr II#!, lost descendant of the #E House of Duggmöggen#! and the true and rightful King of the #E Third Kingdom of Srrørum#!, a realm that expands from the Western Door to the Silver Caves!'

'My armies will march across mountains, forests, and deserts until my people once again extend from the #E Green Valley#! to the #E Dragon's Pass#!! Our cities will be grand and our coffers full, and I will bring the Silver Dwarves into a Golden Age of prosperity unseen since the #E Mythic Age#!!'

As silence dominates the great hall, #E Hefdarr II#! places the crown atop his own head and sits on his throne. Shouts break the silence, cheering"

name: Hartbaltt
code:
me_duggmannrum_28_desc: "Weeks of consistent expeditions into the catacombs have bore no fruit, and doubt begins to sprout in the mind of the young king.

'#G What was he even looking for?#!'

'#G How does he even know this would help unify the valley?#!'

'#G How does he know this even exists?#!'

'#G What if my father was wrong?#!'

#E [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! pauses for a second, shocked he would lose faith so easily in a man who spent his life ensuring his son would succeed. The relic must be close, the only question remains is: what is it?

'#Y Sire, we've found something!#!'

Intrigued, #E [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! follows the man through a small crack his men created through a hidden doorway, entering a small chamber with a handful of tomes. Inside, his men are all looking through a thick red book, murmuring anxiously.

Upon seeing their king they bow and give him some space to inspect their find. On the outside the book is nothing special despite being in surprisingly good condition for an older tome. #E [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! opens the book and begins to read.

'#G This cannot be...#!', he mutters. His eyes examine the page as if looking for something to verify his suspicions.

This was it, the key. The secret his father hid from him, or rather, the rumor he had believed in all his life. Although it could be a fake, the book contained the imperial seal of the legendary #E Hefdarr#! himself, a symbol nearly impossible to replicate as the item was lost centuries ago. Reading through the book again confirmed it for him, #E [GetCharacter('(int32)77').GetFirstName]#! was a descendent of the mythical king himself."

name: Ivarr
code:
me_jaraharum_1_desc: "The traitorous nobles proudly burst into the throne room only to be met by laughter. Their personal forces look at each other in confusion as the so-called #R Tyrant King#!'s laughter echoes through the hall.

The now confused nobles demand an answer, only to be met with the axes.

Hours pass and nobles concerned with the plot's success as well as various loyal subjects of the king wait impatiently outside of his throne room, with those who cannot take the suspense frantically searching for a way to enter the great chamber. Finally, after what seemed like days to some, [GetCharacter('(int32)160').GetName] emerges from his throne room he prepares to orate as a crowd of curious servants, worried noblemen, and eager soldiers await his words.

But those words never come.

The triumphant #R Tyrant King#! simply raises one hand, facing his palm towards the crowd, a motion that declares his acquisition of absolute control over the room. Holding the pose for what seems like an eternity, the King steps aside to softly issue a series of commands to his Marshal. Thus, began the #R #E Great Purge#!#!."

name: Ivarr
code:
me_jaraharum_2_desc: "The #E Goblin chiefs#! arrive in awe of the size of the legendary #E Mountain Hold#!, and are greeted by the King with great splendor. They dine in a great hall in the palace and discuss pleasantries and stories across the table. Once everyone has had their fill as the guests awkwardly attempt to engage in conversation with the silent sovereign. His standoffish behaviour insults many of the proud chiefs, who in turn refuse to converse.

Once the embers of any conversation pitter out, [GetCharacter('(int32)160').GetName] calls over an attendant, softly issuing them a command. The confused chieftains look in shock and anger as the #R King's Guard#! outnumbers and surrounds the dinner table. All night the King has used a #E Goblin#! interpreter to speak with his guests, but now the King makes an announcement in #B Oli'le Kana#!:

'The #E Treaty of Two Friends#! has defined our relationship with you #E Kana'i#! for centuries, protecting us both from outsiders and strengthening the bond between our two peoples. However, with new, stronger enemies rising around us, this archaic document is now more of a hindrance to our potential than a guarantor of peace.'

'My Kingdom shall end all infighting, intrigue, and selfish desires, a land where I will rule supreme and act as judge and jury, destroying those who have wronged me and rewarding those loyal to me.'

'My #E Dwarves#! are strong, but we are outnumbered in this battle, we will need your strength whether you lend it to me willingly or not.'

The King procures a document, a copy of the ancient treaty itself. After watching as the King rips the copy and tosses it into a nearby fireplace, the chiefs leave discuss amongst themselves."

name: Ivarr
code:
me_jaraharum_4_desc: "With #E Dolin#! and #E Kana'i#! soldiers now fighting together under [GetCountry('SV0').GetName], [GetCharacter('(int32)160').GetName] can now prepare for his invasions of the lands of the #E Hobgoblins#!.

Vicious fighters, the various #E Hobgoblin#! tribes have different specialities that would have been easy to exploit if they were divided, however the powerful [GetCountry('HOB').GetName] horde now controls the entire might of the #E Droitrai#!.

Eager #E Kana'i#! war leaders have petitioned the King to invest into chariots for the #E Goblinic#! contingents of the army, as well as relying more on them as their wave tactics have proven effective against #E Hobgoblin#! raiders in the past.

However, #E Dwarven#! commanders urge the kind to stick to tried and true methods: emphasized use of dwarven heavy infantry and siege tactics. They argue that our tight formations and stronger armor will overpower the loosely coordinated #E Driotrai#!, who will flee to neighboring forts where our forces can starve them out.

Both doctrines have their benefit, however one must be favored over the other."

name: Ivarr
code: me_jaraharum_5_desc: "Once a small settlement, the #E Wizard City of#! [GetProvince('(int32)5562').GetName|Y] now boasts a small community of #E Dwarven#! apprentices, #E Hobgoblin#! mages, and various merchants, shopkeepers, craftsmen and more!\n\nWhile this development is impressive, what is important to [GetCharacter('(int32)160').GetName] is that he now has a space to conduct his research, clearing a room in the #E Magic Academy#! for himself where he spends hours pouring over texts and grilling more experienced mages for their knowledge."

name: Dasrunp
code:
me_saptarum_13_desc: "The weak man is pushed by guards into the King's throne room, collapsing onto the floor in front of him. Forced to kneel in front of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName], [GetCharacter('(int32)326').GetName] looks up with eyes full of hatred at the man who desecrated the legacy of the Great #R #E Zanis Zani#!#!.

The pale imitation of what was once the great #E Nazani Emperor#! shouts in defiance in the Weagelian tongue,

'My empire has fallen, yet I still live. Face me, man to man, and allow me to either avenge my people or die alongside them'."

name: Dasrunp
code:
me_saptarum_14_desc: "The duel lasts two minutes, as recalled by those present.

Despite his demeanor and health, [GetCharacter('(int32)326').GetName] briefly had [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName] on the defense.

An exchange of blows followed where the King struck the Emperor fatally.

As the frail man collapsed, the King triumphantly raised his hammer as he was met by a roar of approval.

Even though his body defied him, the dying emperor's spirit would not relent. One quick and precise strike left the King with one final reminder of the strength of the heirs of #E #R Zanis#!#!.

In a rage-filled fury the King finally strikes down the Emperor, ending the #E Nazani#! line and procuring cheers of celebration from the crowd.

The King orders his comrades to be silent, as he calls for the former Emperor's attendants to take his body back to #E Weagelia#!. Despite their legendary grudges, there is one universal thing that any dwarf can respect: courage."

name: Galmarr
code:
me_saptarum_19_desc: "Through our conquests and destruction we have managed to accrue a large amount of wealth that the King has reinvested into our capital. Through careful planning and large projects, the city once nicknamed the #R #E 'Ruined City'#!#! has risen alongside our kingdom to become the jewel of our empire. Our new #E #R 'Forrj City'#!#! will be recognized by all as one of the premier cities of the world, a true mountain metropolis!

'Our domain now ecompasses nearly all of #E Northern Morrigon#!, and our new status as a major power of #E Omniluxia#! should be recognized by all. No longer are we simply the #E Saptans#! of the #E Saptarum Kingdom#!, but the reborn sons of [GetCharacter('(int32)73').GetName], an empire reborn from the burning of our ancient enemy, whos souls fuel our ascendance.'

Thus declared [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName], the first #E Emperor#! of #E #R Forrjkheim#!#!."

name: Hthgart
code: me_saptarum_20_desc: "A whole year as passed since the rebuilding of #E Wegalia#! was started. #E Dwarf#! and #E Human#! alike have worked side-by-side to rebuild the damage done by marauding bandits, rouge soldiers, and the King's revenge. Together, the #E Galmar#! and the #E Leslesi#! have been able to repopulate the ruined cities of #E Wegalia#!, bringing peace and stability to the lands East of the #E Wall of God#!.\n\nTruly our people have been blessed by the great [GetCharacter('(int32)64').GetName] and [GetCharacter('(int32)74').GetName], as we can finally work towards a lasting peace with the #E Geallians#! who we've spent hundred of years hating."

name: Ferja
code: me_saptarum_20_desc: "A whole year as passed since the rebuilding of #E Wegalia#! was started. #E Dwarf#! and #E Human#! alike have worked side-by-side to rebuild the damage done by marauding bandits, rouge soldiers, and the King's revenge. Together, the #E Galmar#! and the #E Leslesi#! have been able to repopulate the ruined cities of #E Wegalia#!, bringing peace and stability to the lands East of the #E Wall of God#!.\n\nTruly our people have been blessed by the great [GetCharacter('(int32)64').GetName] and [GetCharacter('(int32)74').GetName], as we can finally work towards a lasting peace with the #E Geallians#! who we've spent hundred of years hating."

name: Hthgart
code:
03_srrorum_DESCRIPTION: "With the #E Green Valley#! united for the first time in centuries, our people can now focus on reclaiming the full borders of #E [GetCharacter('(int32)64').GetFirstName]'s Kingdom#!. Our people once built great cities across the #E Gorrskkóen Forests#!, along the rocky coasts of the #E Southern Sea#!, and deep inside the #E Dragon's Pass#!!

The end of our Golden Age is filled with mysteries, but certain grudges have withstood the test of time. Following the death of the #E Sacred Pair#!, our lands were invaded by #E Elves#!, #E Hobgoblins#!, and #E Dragkhans#!, pitiful races that envied our lavish cities. Our people were pushed back to our homeland of the #E Green Valley#! with a few scattered settlements across #E Morrigon#!. Slowly, those that resisted were destroyed and forgotten.

With #E Srrørum#! restored, our people can once again dream of #E Srrøkheim#!, and recreating #E Southern Morrigon#! in our image!"

name: Jor-Cymeva
code: 03_cymeva_DESCRIPTION: "Following the deaths of both #E Calidriel#! and #E Cymeva#!, the #E High Elven#! kingdoms of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] and [GetCountry('ATH').GetName] coexisted in accordance with the #E #G Great High Elven Peace#!#!.\n\nThe Cymevans under [GetCharacter('(int32)113').GetName] have used the last two hundred years of peace to settle parts of #E Northern Eptelon#! as well as send out #E #R Slaver Ships#!#! to raid the coasts of #E Arteon#! and #E Eptelon#!. Focusing on rebuilding their economy, forming a professional standing army of elite soldiers, and accruing slaves to do the menial labor so that elven men may join the army, the Cymevans are prepared to finally challenge [GetCharacter('(int32)22').GetName] for control of #E Horteon#!!"

name: Jor-Calidriel
code: 03_cymeva_DESCRIPTION: "Following the deaths of both #E Calidriel#! and #E Cymeva#!, the #E High Elven#! kingdoms of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] and [GetCountry('ATH').GetName] coexisted in accordance with the #E #G Great High Elven Peace#!#!.\n\nThe Cymevans under [GetCharacter('(int32)113').GetName] have used the last two hundred years of peace to settle parts of #E Northern Eptelon#! as well as send out #E #R Slaver Ships#!#! to raid the coasts of #E Arteon#! and #E Eptelon#!. Focusing on rebuilding their economy, forming a professional standing army of elite soldiers, and accruing slaves to do the menial labor so that elven men may join the army, the Cymevans are prepared to finally challenge [GetCharacter('(int32)22').GetName] for control of #E Horteon#!!"

name: Jor-Cymeva
code: 03_cymeva_task_2_DESC: "Traditional elven warriors fight in half-plated steel armor, either accompanied with a longbow or with a #E Trac#!, called a 'Glaive' by the #E Horteonians#!. Under [GetCharacter('(int32)113').GetName] we have established a professional army, so now it is imperative that we select the best of the best to form an elite unite of warriors to serve as shock infantry for the battles to come: the #E Vaur-Ac Warriors#!."

name: Jor-Cymeva
code:
me_cymeva_2_desc: "For close to five centuries our people have been divided between the two #E Elfrealms#! of #E Horteon#!, stifling our growth and costing us our empire.

No longer shall we accept this status quo!

Messengers have already been sent to the colonies, calling for additional manpower to bolster our forces. Our #E Horteonian#! subjects as recruited to serve as scouts and auxiliaries. Our armies now march with purpose towards [GetProvince('(int32)142').GetName|Y], seeking to fulfill #E [GetCharacter('(int32)113').GetFirstName]'s#! dream to restore the #E High Order#! and the #E Ascendic Empire#! under our rightful rule, as the true successors of #E Atheus the Conqueror#!!"

name: Jor-Cymeva
code:
me_cymeva_3_desc: "My lord, terrible news. It seems that the presumptuous and prideful [GetCharacter('(int32)113').GetName] has let his greed and ambition get in the way of reason!

The forces of [GetCountry('ACY').GetName] now march on our lands, seeking to take [GetProvince('(int32)142').GetName|Y] and reunite the #E High Order of Atheus#!.

However, this fight is far from over, and we are more than able to defeat this upstart on the battlefield. Their troops are trained as professional soldiers much like in the days of #E Atheus the Great#!, but what we lack in quality we more than make up in quantity.

Should we defeat the #E Cymevans#!, there is hope that we could unite the #E Elfrealms#! of the north under our banner, and finally honor the legacy of #E Atheus#!!"

name: Jor-Cymeva
code:
me_cymeva_4_desc: "My King, word has come from our overlord, [GetCharacter('(int32)113').GetName]! He demands men and gold for his war to unite the #E Elfrealms#! of #E Horteon#! under his banner!

Obviously our men are eager to serve alongside their countrymen in #E Horteon#!, and I have no doubts of your loyalty to [GetProvince('(int32)345').GetName|Y], but there have been murmurs of dissent coming from both the government and the people.

Speculations that the #E Cymevans#! see us nothing more as extra manpower have begun circulating, and there are those that would prefer to see our overlord punished rather than succeed.

Of course, the loyalty of the men and of the people is to you, my King. We shall follow you to the battlefield, whether it be against or for the #E Cymevans#!."

name: Jor-Cymeva
code:
me_cymeva_5_desc: "Great #E [GetCharacter('(int32)113').GetFirstName]#!, terrible news from the colonies! It seems that our colony, [SCOPE.sCountry('horteonic_subject').GetName], has responded to our call to arms with a declaration of independence!

Normally, crushing their small army would not be a troubling affair, our current campaign against [GetCountry('ATH').GetName] means that we cannot afford to stretch our forces too thin!

Great King, I know your wisdom will see us through this turmoil. Should we win this war quickly, the traitors shall be punished!"

name: Eudocia
code:
03_dune1_DESCRIPTION: "Ever since the fall of the #E 30th Dynasty#! and the capture of [GetProvince('(int32)2805').GetName], the native #E Baetepians#! have never ruled more than small kingdoms in the #E Upper Baetep#!, subjects in their own homeland. While the #Y Lower Baetepians#! saw greater assimilation into #E Geallian#! society, the #G Upper Baetepians#! under the new #E 31st Dynasty#!, the #E Djedhid#!, fiercly defended their independence, only seeing brief periods of subjugation.

Despite their numerous attempts to retake their homelands, the various Upper Baetepian Kingdoms have failed to reclaim the provinces of #E Lower Baetep#!, as the occupying #E Geallian#! forces always fought fiercly to protect one of their most valuable provinces. However, the Invasions of #E #R Jarenam the Formidable Dragon#!#! and the unpopularity of the #R #E Sertemic Dynasty of Baetep#!#! have opened up a new opportunity for the inhabitants of the south.

Allied together in a common cause, the once-rival states of [GetCountry('DUN').GetName] and [GetCountry('AGE').GetName] now seek to place [GetCharacter('(int32)1').GetName] on the #E Pomegranate Throne#!!"

name: Eudocia
code: 03_dune1_task_1_DESC: "Centuries of infighting and backstabbing amongst the members of the #Y Djedhid#! family have long since extinguished any hope of fulfilling the dreams of the founders of what became the [GetCountry('DUN').GetName|G] and the [GetCountry('AGE').GetName|G]. These meaningless wars amongst brothers has prevented the claimants of the #Y Pomegranate Throne#! from retaking the #Y Baetep#! from the foreign invaders!\n\nNo longer must this be the case! With the rise of the wise [GetCharacter('(int32)1').GetName|Y] and the forward-thinking [GetCharacter('(int32)47').GetName|Y], talks have begun about the possibility of a politival marriage that could finally unite the fractured house."

name: Xacob
code: 03_dune1_task_1_DESC: "Centuries of infighting and backstabbing amongst the members of the #Y Djedhid#! family have long since extinguished any hope of fulfilling the dreams of the founders of what became the [GetCountry('DUN').GetName|G] and the [GetCountry('AGE').GetName|G]. name: Eudocia
code: 03_dune1_task_3_DESC: "As the living avatar of #E #G Khewer#!#!, [GetCharacter('(int32)1').GetName|Y] holds the responsibility of ensuring her connection to the divine is stable and provides victory for our troops in battle!"

name: Eudocia
code: me_dune_1_tooltip.a: "#G [GetCharacter('(int32)1').GetName] will become the avatar of #E Senedejr#!.#!"

name: Eudocia
code: me_dune_1_tooltip.b: "#G [GetCharacter('(int32)1').GetName] will continue to host #E Khewer#!.#!"

name: Eudocia
code:
me_dune_3_desc: "My King, the #E 31st Dynasty#! calls for our aid!

Despite our petty rivalry, the emergence of the #E #R Sertemic Kingdom of Baetep#!#! has posed both a threat and an opportunity we could no longer avoid. Through negotiations, Queen [GetCharacter('(int32)1').GetName] has promised us rule over the #E Upper Baetep#! in exchange for our support in her struggle to reclaim the #E Pomegranate Throne#!. Thus, while we might not agree with the #E House of Djedhid#!, it is better to have a familiar enemy on the throne than a hostile foreigner.

Through our King's passionate oration as well as subtle display of force, the neighboring kingdoms of [GetCountry('AKH').GetName] and [GetCountry('PTH').GetName] have allied themselves to our cause, bolstering our numbers against the #E Sertemic#! threat!"

name: Eudocia
code:
me_dune_4_desc: "My #E Pharon#!, urgent news arrives to us from the south! Invading armies of both the [GetCountry('DUN').GetName] and [GetCountry('AGE').GetName] have crossed into our borders!

While I understand it is preposterous to believe, Queen [GetCharacter('(int32)1').GetName] of the #E 31st Dynasty#! claims the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] under the pretext of being the #E True Pharon#! and descendants of the #E 30th Dynasty#! wiped out by #E #R Zanis the Great#!#! long ago. Alongside her are the #E Agaetepians#! as well as a coalition of the various other independent states of the #E Upper Baetep#! who have sworn fealty to her in exchange for land or wealth.

The #E Djedhid Family#! of the [GetCountry('DUN').GetName] have long been a thorn in the side of the #E #R Zani#!#! and later [GetCountry('EGA').GetName], who never managed to fully wipe them out. They are the final hurdle blocking us from controlling all of the wealth of the #E Tetepen#!, and their defeat shall surely place us as one of the #E Great Powers#! of #E Omniluxia#!!"

name: Sakhir
code:
03_jarenam1_DESCRIPTION: "Despite the impressive conquests of the young #E Jarenam the Formidable Dragon#!, his relatively early death has left his empire unstable. As his generals and tribal heads fought over control of the empire, the #E Phanicians#!, #E Baetepians#!, and #E Etaredicans#! slipped away from the empire's grasp, with many thinking this was the end. However, the ascendant #E House of Totrazi#! managed to consolidate their hold over the throne and the empire through guile, cunning, assasination, and brute force.

 However, now the head of the #E Totraz#!, [GetCharacter('(int32)18').GetName] presides over an empire of discontented subjects from the various cultures and religions present in his empire to scheming nobles planning to take his throne. Through his guidance alone the [GetCountry('JRE').GetRuler.GetName] shall either ascend once again, or crumble into pieces. 
"

name: Sakhir
code: 03_jarenam1_task_1_DESC: "Although #E Qhagan#! [GetCharacter('(int32)18').GetName] has made efforts to unite his fractured empire, notably by marrying an #Y Eteradican#! noblewoman, [GetCharacter('(int32)19').GetName], his many diverse subjects still chafe under his rule.\n\nAsking for advice, his generals and tribal heads suggest uniting them against a common enemy. Calling upon his nobles to supply him with #G Jazari#! horsemen, the mighty #R Qhagan#! prepares to raise a great host to fight his enemies!"

code: 03_jarenam1_task_1_DESC: "Although #E Qhagan#!
