Calling upon his nobles to supply him with #G Jazari#! horsemen, the mighty #R Qhagan#! prepares to raise a great host to fight his enemies!"

name: Sakhir
code: jarenamfall_4_desc: "While alone we would stand no match against the armies of the terrifying [GetCountry('JRE').GetName], the foolish #E Qhagan#! [GetCharacter('(int32)18').GetName] has decided to grind his armies against the hilly and forested lands of the Etaredicans. Their failures might represent and opportunity for us, as we could once again reunite all six Phanician tribes under one banner by freeing them from the oppressive yolk of the #E Jarenamids#!."

name: Naravas
code: jarenamfall_5_desc: "My Qhagan, word has come in that the cowardly [GetCountry('PHK').GetName] has marched their armies into our #E Northern Bhaxnmrechtem#! holdings! It is rumored that [GetCharacter('(int32)0').GetName] is attempting to unite the Phanician people under his rule, and has thus sent his men to free the rebellious #E Domekiri#! and #E Phanuqiyari#! tribes under our rightful rule! With our forces stretched thin trying to defeat the savage #E Etaredicans#!, we now rely on your guidance to deliver us victory against these foreign invaders!"

name: Ara
code: jarenamfall_7_desc: "My Qhagan, I regret to inform you that [GetCharacter('(int32)300').GetName] has declared a formal war against us, claiming our holdings in the #E Northern Bhaxnmrechtem#! region! While our hosts can handle the simple-minded #E Etaredicans#!, the hordes of Sertem dogs that now flood into our lands will be difficult to defeat. We can only hope that your wisdom can see us victorious against the #E Baetepians#!!"

name: Sacil
code: jarenamfall_12_desc: "My Qhagan, terrible news has arrived from the far reaches of the empire! Your cousin, [GetCharacter('(int32)106').GetName], has declared himself #E Qhagan#! of various #E Dragkhanic Tribes#! who now call themselves the #E Great Salahad Ulus#!! They seek to challenge your claim to the throne and restore #E Jarenam's#! empire under their more traditional vision.\n\n With such disaster looming over us, only your keen guidance and blessings from the great Dragons of old can save our people from ruin!"

name: Sacil
code: jarenamfall_12_tooltip: "#R [GetCharacter('(int32)106').GetName] has declared himself the true successor of Jarenam!#!"

name: Sacil
code:
jarenamfall_13_desc: "News about the sickly [GetCountry('JRE').GetName] has arrived to us from #E Western Luxterra#!! The #E Dragkhanic#! successors to #E Jarenam the Formidable#! now fight over what is left of his once-mighty empire!

With #E Sakhir's War#! going poorly for the #E Jazari#! and much of their subjects up in arms, many chiefs believe the current Qhagan to be too weak to be in control of the empire. These chiefs have thrown their support behind the Qhagan's more traditional cousin, [GetCharacter('(int32)106').GetName].

A cruel and hawkish man, his demeanor has led many of [GetCharacter('(int32)18').GetName]'s traditional #E Dragkhanic#! followers to step back and observe the fighting, believing that the only the strongest would be worthy of being Qhagan. Declaring himself the rightful Qhagan of his new #E Great Salahad Ulus#!, [GetCharacter('(int32)106').GetFirstName] has openly rebelled against his cousin's rule!

 With their empire crumbling, it can be said that this is the end of the once-great [GetCountry('JRE').GetName]!"

name: Sakhir
code:
jarenamfall_14_desc: "This morning, some uninvited guests arrived at our court in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName] with terrible news, my [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRulerTitle]. The armies of [GetCharacter('(int32)18').GetName] and [GetCharacter('(int32)106').GetName] have laid waste to #E Bhaxnmrechtem#! in their struggle over control of what remains of #E Jarenam the Formidable#!'s empire. The ensuing destruction that's taking place defies belief - we shall spare you the details - but know that the smoke of burning cities can be seen from Morrigon.

Yet all is not lost; many nobles from the great tribes of who once followed #E Jarenam#! managed to escape, and hundreds of refugee ships have sailed across the #E Intergealian Sea#! for the safe harbors of [GetProvince('(int32)5017').GetName] - but what a tragedy! The same Dragkhanic city that launched the invasion of Luxterra now sees its broken sons and daughters return empty-handed.

name: Tsunndomtu
code:
me_nazani.201.desc: "The doors of the throne room are thrown open without ceremony, and [GetCharacter('(int32)328').GetName] strides in at the head of his own retainers. There is no bow, no greeting fit for a #P Purple Emperor#! — only the cold stare of an heir who has decided he has waited long enough.

He does not ask. He demands. The diadem of the west is to pass to him now, while he is young enough to wear it and strong enough to defend it. The court holds its breath, for every soldier and courtier in the hall can see that [GetCharacter('(int32)328').GetName] has not come to petition [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y] — he has come to replace him.

To yield is to hand away the throne and, perhaps, one's very eyes. To refuse is to invite the swords already gathering behind him. The Empire of the West waits upon a single word."

name: Dasrunp
code:
me_nazani.202.desc: "The purple is yours now, and the palace has learned to bow to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y]. Yet one shadow remains across the new reign; the old emperor [GetCharacter('(int32)326').GetName] still breathes, and a deposed emperor left whole and free is a rebellion waiting for a season.

The court remembers the old remedy of the eastern Zani, practiced upon rivals for a thousand years. A man robbed of his sight can never again sit the throne, for no blind man may rule — yet mercy of a kind lets him keep his life. Iron waits in the brazier, and the guards await only a nod.

What is done tonight cannot be undone at dawn."

name: Dasrunp
code: me_nazani.202.a.tt: "[GetCharacter('(int32)326').GetName] will be #R blinded#! and cast into #Y exile#! beyond our borders."

name: Dasrunp
code:
me_nazani.203.desc: "A ragged party arrives at the court of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetName|Y], and at its center is a broken figure whose bearing still betrays the purple he once wore. This is [GetCharacter('(int32)326').GetName|Y], the former #P Emperor#! of the #Y Nazani Empire#! that was deposed by his cousin.

The tragic tale of Dasrunp spills out from his escort. The old emperor was seized in the dead of night, his eyes put out with hot iron, and then cast beyond the borders of his own realm to die a beggar in foreign lands. That he came to rest in our territory is chance — but a blinded Emperor at one's court is never merely a guest.

He cannot rule, he cannot fight, and he cannot see. But his blood and his grievance are worth a great deal to whoever decides what becomes of him."

name: Zanis
code:
lorestart.1.desc: "The mighty #T Eastern Empire of the Zani#!, born from the chaos that followed the #R Great Collapse#!, has been led by the #Y Razani#! wing of the #T Zani Family#! since the #R Great Split of 690 LC#!. Just like their western counterparts, the Razani lay claim to the legacy of [GetCharacter('(int32)168').GetName|Y], and argue that their connection is stronger due to their control of his imperial capital of [GetProvince('(int32)2478').GetName|G] .

Ruling over the 'True Geallians' from the #G Unconquered City#!, the #Y Razani#!'s influence has waned in the past few centuries, losing many former imperial provinces to revolts or invasions. The #T Helluvian Heresy#! in particular has taken its toll on the religious unity of the Empire, with once-loyal groups such as the #Y Ytalians#! now questioning their loyalty to the Emperor.

Still reeling from their near-destruction at the hands of #T Jarenam the Formidable Dragon#!, the #Y Razani#! under the aging [GetCharacter('(int32)228').GetName|Y] now face internal forces that threaten to tear apart their crumbling empire. Due to his lack of a clear heir, uneasy whispers permeate the walls of the #G Blue Marble Palace#!. While many in the palace support the emperor's son, [GetCharacter('(int32)229').GetFirstName|Y], his lack of military experience makes him an unacceptable candidate in the eyes of most of those on the #T Imperial Council#!. The families of the council alongside several #T Gonessemshom#! have instead put their support behind the young #Y Uzani#! general [GetCharacter('(int32)125').GetFirstName|Y], a war hero whose deeds earned him the position of Gonessemshom of what's left of the [GetCountry('EGM').GetName|Y].

Outside the palace walls, the wanton consequences of the #T Theon System#! have made administration of the empire increasingly difficult and volatile. Although initially efficient at defending against the invaders that threatened the early #Y Razani#! emperors, the entrenched Esemamshauzas and Gonessemshoms across the empire act more akin to vassals than provinces. Their loyalty is questionable at best, and with a civil war on the horizon, the empire can only pray they remain apathetic to court politics.

On top of internal issues, the Empire must now defend their vast territories from both nomadic invaders as well as the various kingdoms and empires on their borders without the support of the wealthy Baetep province, lost to the cowardly #T House of Sertem#! during the #T Invasions of Jarenam#!.

With civil war and external invasions seemingly imminent, can the aging ruler of the #Y Razani#! find a solution that could save the Empire of the 'True Geallians'?"

name: Dasrunp
code:
lorestart.2.desc: "The #T Western Empire of the Zani#!, one of the two states emerging from the #R Great Split of 690 LC#! which followed the #R Great Collapse#!, are led by the #Y Weagelians#!, sons of #Y Geallian#! invaders and the native peoples of #Y Weagelia#!. The last three hundred years of relatively stable rule has given the leading #T House of Nazani#! a reputation as more than just a cadet branch of the #T Zani Family#!, as they are known among their people as the #Y Emperors of the West#! first and foremost.

However, this stability and growth did not come without any losses. First giving up the #G Borderlands#! to native rebels in 697 LC and then Kainaxarthos to the [GetCountry('SOV').GetName|R] in 795 LC, many assumed that their hold on their continent would slip to younger empires like their eastern counterpart.

Recognizing this threat, Emperor [GetCharacter('(int32)326').GetName|Y] decided to act following the decisive loss of the #G Marshlands#! after centuries of stubborn native resistance. Focusing inwards, the Emperor developed his cities and farmlands, stabilizing the realm while filling his ranks with able-bodied men. Watching the success of his endeavors, the cautious Emperor decided to expand the #Y Nazani#!'s influence through more subtle means rather than make rash offensive decisions.

Secretly supporting the developing #R Orcish colonies#!, the #Y Nazani#! have strategically been destabilizing and weakening the #Y Borderlander#! and #Y Celtican#! tribes. Should the cautious Emperor decide to decisively strike, they are sure to reconquer the divided #G Borderlands#!.

With relatively few enemies who can match their strength and a stable state loyal to its Emperor. The only threat to the Emperor's power are a number of small heretical #T Helluvian#! communities spreading across his nation like a plague. Despite this, the #Y Nazani#! are in an enviable position, poised to become one of the #G Great Powers#! of #G Omniluxia#!."

name: Aonghullean
code:
lorestart.4.desc: "The Empire of #T Uttarasmake the Great#! started out as a group of Dragkhanic clans living under the shadow of the #G Celica Mountains#! centuries ago. Under the leadership of the #Y Soveneria#! clan, hordes of dragkhanic horsemen took advantage of the #R Second Marshlander Revolt#! to invade the wealthy Nazani province of #G Kainaxarthos#!.

 The following #R Nazani-Sovenerian War#! saw the #R [GetCountry('WGA').GetName|Y]#! retreat from southern #G Morrigon#! in 795 LC, allowing the victorious #T Soventeir Ulus#! to conquer most of their former territories. With no other rivals able to match their strength, the Sovenerians invaded the remaining dragkhanic clans, controlling most of southern Morrigon by 852 LC.

 In this environment, #T Uttarasmake the Great#! was declared #T Qhagan#! of Soveneria in 868 LC. Taught by #T Helluvian#! missionaries, the new Qhagan was a Zanophile who promoted the culture and traditions of the #Y Geallian#! #Y Kainaxari#! people in his borders. Seeking to further imitate the Zani, he declared himself #T Shanuzushanuz#! of the [GetCountry('SOV').GetName|Y] in 874 LC, as well as formally converting to Helluvianism. Claiming to be the legitimate heir of the #T Zani Empire#!, he spent the remainder of his reign spreading Helluvianism to his dragkhanic subjects, morphing and replacing cruel dragkhanic traditions with Helluvian or #Y Geallian#! ones, as well as crushing all threats to his power. This included defeating and selling the hostile #R Jazari#! tribes to the [GetCountry('EGA').GetName|Y] in 870 LC.

However, the centuries have not been kind to the great #T Empire of the Zanic Dragkhans#!, as the years of prosperity and stability have allowed for corruption and complacency to seep into Sovenerian society.

Seeking to emulate the recent successes of his Nazani counterpart, the young [GetCharacter('(int32)165').GetName|Y] was declared #T Shanuzushanuz#! of the [GetCountry('SOV').GetName|Y] in 999 LC. With the new millennium comes a new beginning, and he has vowed to banish corrupt officials and bring the empire to new heights.

However, with corrupt officials endorsing his brother [GetCharacter('(int32)111').GetName|Y] for the throne, unrest growing amongst their more traditionally dragkhanic subjects, and rumors of a #R Hobgoblin#! horde growing in the north, the young emperor has much work to be done."

name: Girm
code:
lorestart.5.desc: "The #R Great [GetCountry('HOB').GetName|Y] Horde#! was forged by blood through the conquests of the great Droishu warlord [GetCharacter('(int32)63').GetName|Y] of the #Y Zalthu Clan#!. Controlling all the #R Hobgoblins#! of the #G Dragon's Pass#! by 998 LC, the great chief left his realm to his eldest son, [GetCharacter('(int32)86').GetName|Y], and the city of [GetProvince('(int32)4187').GetName|G] to his younger son [GetCharacter('(int32)84').GetName|Y], before finally laying to rest in 999 LC.

While the #R Hobgoblins#! are united in the face of foreign hostiliy, centuries of isolation and distance has led them to divide themselves into complicated polities led by clans and blood-ties. With loyalties changing on a whim, true unity seemed like a distant dream until [GetCharacter('(int32)63').GetFirstName|Y] led his clan to war against all others, rewarding those loyal to him based on merit rather than on clan affiliation.

Left with a realm of disparate tribes only recently united, the great [GetCharacter('(int32)86').GetName|Y] will have to unite the #T Five Great Tribes#! and the #T Two Great Cities#! under one banner, and lead the many sons of #Y Melodias#! against the hostile peoples that exist beyond the #G Dragon's Pass#!. 

The #R Hobgoblins#!, rumored to be a twisted mixture of #Y Elvish#! and #Y Goblinic#! blood, are a warlike and unruly people not united since the ascendance of the #Y Zalthu Clan#!. From the skilled horsemen of the #Y Urhuk#! clans, to the #Y Shoishoni#! mages of [GetProvince('(int32)4187').GetName|G], to the hardy mountain warriors of the #Y Jishani#! and #Y Ahualtzi#! peoples, their warbands are only matched by the organization and unity of more settled peoples. Should the #Y Zalthu#! be able to utilize their full strength, they could easily create a force able to conquer all of #G Morrigon#!, and make a name for themselves in the history of #G Omniluxia#!!"

name: Ctesiphon
code:
lorestart.6.desc: "Following the fall of the #R Zakara Kephal#! and the #G Sacking of [GetProvince('(int32)4662').GetName|G]#! in 946 LC, the once-mighty #Y Zarakens#! of the #G Eastern Foothills#! have been reduced to a mere imitation of their former empires. Now just a rump state restricted to their core territories, the few surviving members of the ancient #T House of Zakara#! are now left to rebuild their broken empire amidst the various hostile #Y Zainudians#! and nomadic raiders.

Seen as heretics by the divided #Y Zinduidians#! for their friendly attitudes towards #T Helluvian#! merchants, the tolerant [GetCharacter('(int32)10').GetName|Y] now looks north for expansion and opportunities.

Should this great king reclaim his people's empire, many believe he may try to return the #Y Zarakens#! to their roots, ridding them of the influence of the cursed prophets."

name: Nassaar
code:
lorestart.8.desc: "After the spectacular collapse of the unequal and cruel #R Zakara Kephal#! at the hands of the #T Great Zinduidian Revolt#! of 934 LC, the various #Y Zainudian#! faithful have splintered into their original tribal groups that preceeded the mighty #G Zi'had Kephal#!.

While the #Y Zinduidian#! tribes squabble for amongst themselves, the emergent [GetCountry('KAF').GetName|Y] and crumbling [GetCountry('JRE').GetName|Y] pose a significant threat to the safety of the holy city of [GetProvince('(int32)4790').GetName|G]. Having recently overthrown foreign heretics, the #Y Zinduidians#! are fiercly hostile to those who would seek to emulate the #R Zakaran Kalifs#!. However, there remains hope that a #T Zinduidian Kalif#! will one day unite the #Y Zainudians#! under his rule, treating all equally and destroying the heretical #R Helluvians#!.

While many look to the independent city of [GetCountry('ZTC').GetName|Y] for guidance, a warlord by the name of [GetCharacter('(int32)38').GetName|Y] has been expanding his realm with dreams of making his capital a city to rival [GetProvince('(int32)4790').GetName|G]'s splendor.

To the east lie the various #Y Zarakens#! peoples. Much like their #Y Zinduidian#! neighbors, they too were treated like second-class citizens under the rule of the empire of #T Daro Zakara#!. With the [GetCountry('ZAK').GetName|Y] once again looking to expand their influence, many of these smaller states have banded together to preserve their indepedence.

Whoever comes out victorious in this power struggle will have the responsibility of nurturing and spreading the #Y Zainudian#! faith, as #T Zain'ud#! told the prophets:

#R 'I am #T Zain'ud#! and my word is law, hear me now, this is my final message: Spread my word to the ends of this world, and tell the devoted to come and pray to me at this altar.#!' - The Second Revelation (Dacañan)"

name: Hthgart
code:
lorestart.10.desc: "The #Y Silver Dwarves#! of #G Morrigon#! are possibly the oldest race on the continent. Emerging long before even the ancient #Y Goblins#! or #Y Elves#!, the oldest stories recount how they ruled much of #G Southern Morrigon#! during the #T First Kingdom of Srrørum#!, enjoying the relative peace and stability under the rule of the demi-god twins [GetCharacter('(int32)64').GetFirstName|Y] and [GetCharacter('(int32)74').GetFirstName|Y].

However, the end of the #T Dwarven Golden Age#! marked the decline of their civilization, and it is said that the few remaining survivors were pushed back all the way to the homelands of the #Y Silver Dwarven#! people, the #G Green Valley#!. There, the few fractured clans fought amongst themselves over the former territories of the #T Silver Kingdom#!, ushering in millennia of unending wars that destroyed much of what was left of [GetCharacter('(int32)64').GetFirstName|Y]'s realm. Thousands fled the valley for the uncertainty of the outside world, and those that remained were forced to either participate in the fighting or submit to belligerent petty kings.

The endless bloodshed only ended during the great #T Unification Wars#! waged by the legendary king, [GetCharacter('(int32)65').GetName|Y]. From his castle at what would become [GetProvince('(int32)3883').GetName|G], the ambitious prince of #Y Duggmannri#! fought hundreds of spectacular battles to unite the #Y Anvindr#! under one banner. With the capture of the last pockets of resistance at [GetProvince('(int32)4048').GetName|G], [GetCharacter('(int32)65').GetFirstName|Y] was declared the great #Y Togg#! of the #T Second Kingdom of Srrørum#! in 610 LC.

Tales of the legendary 59 year reign of the #T God of War#! claim he connected and developed his kingdom, patronized the Order of Sennmoggen, ordered the construction of great works like Gerrbaen, and even defeated a #Y Zani#! army sent to subjugate him. Despite having to deal will several dissenting nobles, notably the infamous #T Prince Harttol#!, all #Y Anvindr#! Silver Dwarves grew to view him as the second father of their people. So beloved was he, that on the first full moon of every year every Silver Dwarf in the #G Green Valley#! takes a minute to participate in the #Y Thrygg#! to mourn his passing.

In the centuries since then the #G Green Valley#! has seen the rise and fall of many petty despots and cruel tyrants, however none have ever managed to restore the great kingdom of the #T True King#! since its dissolution following his death. From hundreds of principalities and city-states only six nations remain, maintaining a delicate balance of power: [GetCountry('SV1').GetName|Y], [GetCountry('SV3').GetName|Y], [GetCountry('SV5').GetName|Y], [GetCountry('SV6').GetName|Y], [GetCountry('SV8').GetName|Y], and [GetCountry('SV7').GetName|Y].

Although they currently enjoy a moment of peace, war is inevitably on the horizon. The only way out of this period of warring states is the reunification of the #G Green Valley#! and the restoration of #G Srrørum#!, a feat so legendary only two figures in all of #Y Silver Dwarven#! history have been able to achieve it. Will the next great king of the #Y Anvindr#! be yours?"

name: Sakhir
code:
lorestart.11.desc: "Whether adored or feared, it cannot be denied that the conquests of the great Qhagan #T Jarenam the Formidable Dragon#! have forever changed the political and cultural landscape of #G Western Luxterra#!

Freeing many peoples who were under #Y Zanic#! rule for centuries such as the #Y Baetepians#! and #Y Phanicians#!, subjugating the #Y Esquelians#! with the help of #Y Eteradican#! auxiliaries, and accidentally setting the groundwork for the founding of the emergent [GetCountry('KAF').GetName|Y] in the west, the Empire at its height rivaled the grandness of even the #Y Zani#!.

However, the collapse of #Y Jarenam#!'s legacy led to a moment of weakness, during which the various vultures big and small picked apart pieces of his empire for their own. The realm stabilized under the ascent of the cunning [GetCharacter('(int32)18').GetName|Y] in 998 LC, but the damage was already done.

The #Y Phanicians#! have carved out two rival kingdoms, eyeing up their comrades still under #Y Totrazi#! rule.

The [GetCountry('EGY').GetName|Y] took the opportunity to consolidate its power under the cowardly #Y Sertems#!, now seeking to make itself the strongest power in #G Western Luxterra#!. The #T Majarian Kingdom#!, ruled by former #Y Alaguric#! mercenaries of the [GetCountry('EGA').GetName|Y], now stand as nothing more than a symbol of this imperialist attitude towards the west.

The various #Y Esquelian#! and #Y Eteradicans#! of #G Central Bhaxnmrechtem#! have fought guerilla campaigns to harass and cripple the empire's ability to secure its own borders while also stoking the flames of ethnic uprisings within #Y Totrazi#! borders.

The #Y Gold Dwarves#! are too occupied with the reconstruction of their states, and the #Y Kaffarians#! and #Y Zinduidians#! to the east have no interest in #G Western Luxterra#! at the moment.

Ruling an unstable empire with enemies on all sides, [GetCharacter('(int32)18').GetName|Y] must find a way to save #Y Jarenam#!'s vision before the circling vultures descend on his crumbling state!"

name: Dasrunp
code:
lorestart.13.desc: "Centuries have passed since the #T Great Borderlander Revolt#! and yet the #Y Native Morrigonians#! to the west of the [GetCountry('WGA').GetName|Y] have not managed to unite, and have instead regressed to their traditional tribal lifestyles.

However, all is not well in the #G Borderlands#!, as the #Y Northern Borderlanders#! face the wrath of invading #Y Orcish#! colonies said to be funded by the #Y Nazani#! to destabilize the region. The great backstab of the #Y Leslesi#! tribes has proved to be a grave mistake, as the re-emergent [GetCountry('SV2').GetName|Y] now looks to avenge their allies.

In the south, the #Y Marshlanders#! have enjoyed seven years of peace with the [GetCountry('WGA').GetName|Y] following their truce with Emperor [GetCharacter('(int32)326').GetName|Y]. However, this brief respite is soon to end, as rumors circulate that Emperor [GetCharacter('(int32)165').GetName|Y] of the [GetCountry('SOV').GetName|Y] plans to expand his empire into the lands of the #Y Marshlanders#!!

Whatever this new millennium will throw at them, the resilient #Y Borderlanders#! and #Y Marshlanders#! will be able to manage them, once again preserving their people and heritage."

name: Aonghullean
code:
lorestart.13.desc: "Centuries have passed since the #T Great Borderlander Revolt#! and yet the #Y Native Morrigonians#! to the west of the [GetCountry('WGA').GetName|Y] have not managed to unite, and have instead regressed to their traditional tribal lifestyles.

However, all is not well in the #G Borderlands#!, as the #Y Northern Borderlanders#! face the wrath of invading #Y Orcish#! colonies said to be funded by the #Y Nazani#! to destabilize the region. The great backstab of the #Y Leslesi#! tribes has proved to be a grave mistake, as the re-emergent [GetCountry('SV2').GetName|Y] now looks to avenge their allies.

name: Hiladriel
code:
lorestart.15.desc: "The island of #G Arteon#! has suffered greatly for many centuries, perhaps moreso than any other place within #G Omniluxia#!, as #Y High Elven#! invasions from abroad and internal dissension between the settled human tribes have brought a state of eternal war to the island. The #T First Great War of Arteon#! and the expansion of the #Y High Elven Colonies#! resulted in the native Arteonians losing many of their coastal territories to High Elves, and native armies are gathering in the interior of the island for a campaign to retake these lands.

In this environment, the Alu-sarian half elves were born from the union of the fleeing pacifist #Y Alusian#! High Elves and the highland #Y Sarian#! tribes. Called 'Emra' by the xenophobic High Elves, this derogatory term is emblematic of their attitudes towards them - disgust and hostility. Living outside the reach of the hostile High Elven colonies, the major Half Elven communities of the region as well as neighboring Alusian and Sarian settlements have recently loosely united under King [GetCharacter('(int32)117').GetName|Y] of the [GetCountry('ALS').GetName|Y] Kingdom.

Meanwhile, the aftermath of both the #T Second Great War of Arteon#! and the #T High Elven Civil War#! has meant that the newly independent colonies of the High Elves no longer had the support of their overlords, allowing the rise of the wealthy [GetCountry('MH1').GetName|Y].

The constant fighting between the major powers of the island allowed for the small city-state of [GetCountry('AR3').GetName|Y] to take over surrounding major cities such as [GetProvince('(int32)791').GetName|G] and [GetProvince('(int32)942').GetName|G]. Their esoteric King, [GetCharacter('(int32)118').GetName|Y] is rumored to be involved with numerous sightings of #R Vampires#! reported on the island.

With the coming of the #T High Elven Peace#! and the return of raids by the #T Great Slaver Navies#!, the tension on the island has only increased. Tens of thousands of soldiers have fallen in the battles between the various factions vying for control of the island, and the cities and ports are filled with ruthless mercenary companies selling their swords to the highest bidder, heartless slavers with thousands of chained thralls and cynical weapon dealers that sell to all sides involved in conflict - there is no escaping the violence on Arteon.

With the island split between the native [GetCountry('MH1').GetName|Y] and the High Elven [GetCountry('DMR').GetName|Y], the winner of this conflict will be decided by the reaction of the various minor players in this inevitable clash of cultures."

name: Akeibavoo
code:
lorestart.16.desc: "For centuries the #Y Gnomes#! of #Y Kemi#! lived peacefully in their snow-filled environment, dedicating themselves to worship and the continuation of their culture and traditions. However, after the #R Great Collapse#! foreigners arrived on the shores of what they called #G Polaria#!. Initially greeting them with open arms, the #Y Gnomes#! learned to fear these new arrivals as their people were pushed further into the ice by the waves of migrating #Y Northerners#!.

Having been pushed out of the fertile plains of the south, the #Y Gnomish#! clans met to decide the fate of their people. Many 'Saamskoo' decided to move north into the inhospitable glaciers where no #Y Polarian#! could reach them, while the remaining 'Jemskoo' were firm in their decision to stay and fight.

However this battle was a losing one, and the short stature of the #Y Gnomes#! combined with their poor martial abilities meant that by 779 LC the #Y Polarians#! had pushed the divided clans into the harsh mountains and hills.

However it was this year that the #G Taalvut Åkoo#! revealed himself to the desperate #Y Jemskoo#!. Teaching them the secrets of #Y Projection Magic#!, the #Y Gnomes#! now had their own giants that they could use against the foreigners. Instructed to build a magic school to teach this #Y Taanka Technique#! to their young mages, the #Y Gnomes#! have been able to greatly develop their magical capabilities in only a few generations.

At the turn of the millennium the #Y Gnomes#! of #G Polaria#! now find themselves united under the #Y Jemskoo#! king [GetCharacter('(int32)112').GetName|Y] and prepared to retake their homeland. In contrast, the last sons of the #R Northern Empire#! are divided into various squabbling clans, their greatest hope being the #Y Bear Hunters#! of [GetCountry('PS4').GetName|Y]. In this critical moment in #Y Polarian#! history, the fate of two peoples shall be decided once the first spark is lit."

name: Jor-Calidriel
code:
lorestart.17.desc: "While skirmishes between the #Y Horteonians#! and the native #Y Gnomes#! took place ever since the #T Horteonian Migrations#!, the #G Continent of Fire and Ice#! saw relative peace as the #Y Horteonians#!, #Y Eptelonians#!, and #Y Arteonians#! traded between themselves and even with the #Y Gnomish#! tribes.

However, the landing of #T Atheus the Conqueror#!'s #T Great Slaver Fleet#! over two thousand years ago brought ruinous war to all those who lived in the #G Melodian Continents#!.

The various #Y Atheusian-Horteonian#! wars saw the borders change, with the #Y Horteonians#! suffering the same fate they inflicted onto the #Y Gnomes#!, retreating further into the hilly interior of the continent.

Despite this tragedy, hope revealed itself to the various human tribes in the form of the #T Great High Elven Civil War#!.

Since the death of #T Atheus the Younger#! in 635 LC, his cousins [GetCharacter('(int32)22').GetName|Y] and [GetCharacter('(int32)113').GetName|Y] split the empire, only briefly pausing to recover their manpower following the #R Great Collapse#!, leading to the #T High Elven Peace#!. With both sides focusing on their lost colonies and each other, a united coalition of #Y Horteonian#! tribes might be able to kick out the invaders once and for all.

Meanwhile, to the North, the neutral #G Gnomish Nookti Cities#! are beacons of civilization among the various nomadic #Y Gnomish#! clans. Should they decide to finally intervene, they might be able to create a better future for the native people of #Y Wuskouu#!!"

name: Grombar
code:
lorestart.24.desc: "The swamps and jungles of [GetProvince('(int32)2060').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName|G] and [GetProvince('(int32)1793').GetArea.GetRegion.GetName|G] are the traditional homelands of the Orcish tribes. While most Orcs live on the Bloody Isles, isolated from the rest of Morrigon, the few 'Gozen Orcs' who decided to leave their island homelands can be found all throughout Morrigon. Their services are in high demand as soldiers and mercenaries, for they are physically hearty and exceptional fighters, and it is not uncommon to find one within the personal retinues of Kings and Emperors throughout Omniluxia.

While the two islands have a shared history and faith, the political and cultural development of the two diverged significantly following the fall of the Great Nuhargorkan. Rendunian Orcs have organized their society around the fortified #Y Nurago#! palaces of the noble #Y Egerya#!, and although their society is more stratified, their large urban settlements and port cities host the few foreigners allowed on Orcish soil. Western Remunian Orcs have adopted the ways of the Big Islanders, however, most Remunians live in clans that roam the various jungles, swamps, and mountains of the Holy Island, practicing traditions that predate the Great Nuhargorkan.

The dominant powers in the Orcish world are the Great Families at the helm of the #Y Nurhanuoragias#!. These great polities command great spiritual and martial power, however, they are also astute when it comes to maintaining their hegemony. Over the centuries, dozens of Nurhanuoragias have risen and fallen, and each Great Family knows that they must fight viciously to maintain their position at the top.

On Rendun, the [GetCountry('BT9').GetName|Y] and [GetCountry('BT6').GetName|Y] families have been ardent rivals for decades, having both risen from the ashes of the [GetCountry('BT5').GetName|Y] family, who once controlled the entirety of the south. To the north, the [GetCountry('BTI').GetName|Y] and [GetCountry('BTF').GetName|Y] families have made an uneasy alliance in an attempt to stop the incredible rise of the [GetCountry('ORC').GetName|Y] family. Once a minor noble family, the [GetCountry('ORC').GetName|Y] have seen explosive growth under M'Orokoro [GetCharacter('(int32)85').GetFirstName|Y], known as 'the Butcher' for his brutal methods of maintaining order. His secretive court is said to worship what they call the 'Black Flame', a barbaric belief that one's Inner Flame can only be regulated through consuming the flames of others. The only lands free from fuedal yoke are the free temples of the [GetCountry('BT4').GetName|Y] monks who reside in Opium Valleys. Due to the high cost of conquering these fearsome warrior-monks, many Nurhanuoragias instead choose to send their sons to learn from the various academies and temples across the monks' domains, further ensuring the independence of these wise holy men.

Across the sea, Remun is dominated by two families, the [GetCountry('BIG').GetName|Y] and the [GetCountry('BI6').GetName|Y]. Having originally come from Rendun, their superior technology, numbers, and political structure has allowed them to dominate the west coast of Remun. Bitter rivals, their expansion has been halted by a mutual distrust of the other and the thick jungles and mountains of the island that protect the native tribes.

Finally, a small band of Orcish adventurers who have called themselves 'Gozon's Chosen' have been rallying the various clans behind their banner. While their aims are unknown, they certainly seem poised to uproot the control of the dominant Iparatai families.

Having been divided for centuries, the idea of a unified Orcish realm is a foreign concept to most Orcs of the Bloody Isles. However, with the world around them finally restoring order centuries after the Great Collapse, the prophesized Krozon may finally arrive!"

name: Eudocia
code:
lorestart.30.desc: "The #Y Upper Baetepians#! that have chafed under #R Zanic#! dominion for centuries now boil in outrage as their northern cousins are once again subjugated to foreign rule!

The silver-tongued #Y Sertem#! that have oppressed the #G Baetep#! for generations now return to rule them in earnest, continuing the Zanic tradition of suppressing the gods of [GetProvince('(int32)2805').GetName|G] that once liberated the #Y Baetepians#! from foreign rule and expanded their empire to become the greatest in #G Luxterra#!.

However, there is still hope. The enduring [GetCountry('DUN').GetName|Y] under the #T True Pharon#! [GetCharacter('(int32)1').GetName|Y] have allied themselves to the rival [GetCountry('AGE').GetName|Y], finally setting their differences aside in order to free their land from the false god #R Zanis#! of the #R Geallians#!.

Waiting for a moment of weakness in the fledgling [GetCountry('EGY').GetName|Y], the alliance plans to finally restore rightful #Y Djehid#! rule to the lands of the #Y Baetepian#! people!"

name: Karakas
code:
lorestart.31.desc: "The #Y Dzunge-dunylin Toçulkar#!, children of the great Sky God #Y Dzunge Duny#!, have for centuries lived at the periphery of the #R Geallian#! world, often raiding their more civilized neighbors as much as they raid each other. Fiercely independent, the divided #Y Duny#! were slowly forced to bend the knee to the #R Zani Empire#!, who pushed into their lands and settled their hunting grounds with foreign peoples.

During the #T Great Invasions#! of the 650s, it seemed that the #Y Duny#! would become just another assimilated people within the great empire, however the heroic #Y Orçuz Gundogdu#! led the five tribes to victory against #R Zanic#! and #Y Selaskusian#! armies, buying the #Y Duny#! enough time for #Y Dzunge Duny#! to intervene. What the #R Geallians#! call the 'Great Collapse', the #Y Duny#! celebrate as the sky god punishing the encroaching #R Zani#! by clouding his realm with a great layer of smoke and shaking the earth as he rained thunderbolts upon the invaders. The weakened #R Zani#! were no match for the hordes of vengeful horsemen that razed many cities of the south, reclaiming their homelands and freedom.

However, the five tribes grew complacent, and continued their nomadic ways while extoriting the southern #Y Ytalians#! for tribute in the form of grain and gold. Thus, while they squabbled amongst themselves for larger portions of tribute, the #R [GetCountry('EGA').GetName|Y]#! consolidated its power over the east. Once they fully recovered from the destructive #R Great Split of 690 LC#!, their armies began to march on the lands of the #Y Duny#!.

Once again it seemed that the sons of #Y Dzunge Duny#! would be destroyed by the #R Geallians#!, however, the sky god once again intervened to save his people. He sent the demon known to the #R Razani#! as #T Jarenam the Formidable Dragon#! to ravage their lands and divide their empire. Once again, the #Y Duny#! hordes descended on the edges of #Y Razani#! territory, and retook their lost lands.

While the [GetCountry('GT1').GetName|Y] and [GetCountry('GT4').GetName|Y] are content with raiding the #Y Ytalians#!, the great chief of the [GetCountry('DNY').GetName|Y], [GetCharacter('(int32)15').GetName|Y], has bigger ideas for the five tribes. Learning from the oral histories, he's determined to break the cycle and ensure prosperity for the divided tribes. His tolerance of conquered people and adoption of their technologies has given him an edge over his rivals. His hosts have so far subdued the [GetCountry('GT3').GetName|Y] and integrated the #Y Teçuklar#!, and he now sets his eyes on the remaining two tribes who are alarmed at his rapid expansion.

Should he be able to unite the #Y Duny#!, the children of #Y Dzunge Duny#! might escape the growing hordes of the south and find true prosperity."

name: O-Yatonn
code:
lorestart.32.desc: "The Kings of [GetCountry('YGA').GetName|Y] have been faithful subjects of the #T Zani Empire#! ever since the founding of their kingdom by #T Cyrogelos the Loyal#!. Located at the southern edges of the #Y Zani#! world, they are known as the defenders of the #G Golden Pathway#!, fighting off nomadic horsemen and goblin hordes, as well as maintaining order in the surrounding regions. Rivals of the warlike #Y Anaktorians#!, the #Y Ytalians#! are a bellicose people whose warriors and military culture laid the foundation for massive armies of the #T Zani Empire#!.

After the #R Great Collapse#! the #Y Ytalians#! continued to serve the weakened [GetCountry('EGA').GetName|Y] loyally, protecting their south from #Y Duny#! and #Y Selaskusian#! hordes, while sending soldiers north to participate in wars against the #Y Illorians#!, #Y Etaredicans#!, and eventually the invading [GetCountry('JRE').GetName|Y].

With the death of King [GetCharacter('(int32)83').GetName|Y] came the question of succession. A friend of [GetCharacter('(int32)228').GetName|Y], [GetCharacter('(int32)83').GetFirstName|Y] enforce his overlord's policy of persecution towards the popular #T Helluvian#! faith, which had come to dominate large parts of eastern and southern #G Ytalia#!. Thus, when his son [GetCharacter('(int32)127').GetFirstName|Y] came to the throne, it came as a surprise when he promoted tolerance amongst the small kingdom, even pardoning and releasing his brother, [GetCharacter('(int32)126').GetName|Y], a devout #T Helluvian#!.

Despite having abandoned his faith, [GetCharacter('(int32)127').GetFirstName|Y] still maintained the #T Cult of Zanis#! as the state religion to placate his overlord, who chafed at the disobediance shown by the young King. For many more radical believers, this was unacceptable. Rumors of rebellion now linger amongst isolated #T Helluvian#! communities, who scoff at the idea of the emperor in [GetProvince('(int32)2478').GetName|G] dictating the fate of their eternal souls.

With unrest building in the eastern regions, can [GetCharacter('(int32)127').GetName|Y] maintain control of his kingdom, or will #G Ytalia#! finally seek its own path free from #Y Zanic#! oppression?"

Located at the southern edges of the #Y Zani#! world, they are known as the defenders of the #G Golden Pathway#!, fighting off nomadic horsemen and goblin hordes, as well as maintaining order in the surrounding regions. Rivals of the warlike #Y Anaktorians#!, the #Y Ytalians#! are a bellicose people whose warriors and military culture laid the foundation for massive armies of the #T Zani Empire#!.

After the #R Great Collapse#! the #Y Ytalians#! continued to serve the weakened [GetCountry('EGA').GetName|Y] loyally, protecting their south from #Y Duny#! and #Y Selaskusian#! hordes, while sending soldiers north to participate in wars against the #Y Illorians#!, #Y Etaredicans#!, and eventually the invading [GetCountry('JRE').GetName|Y].

With the death of King [GetCharacter('(int32)83').GetName|Y] came the question of succession. A friend of [GetCharacter('(int32)228').GetName|Y], [GetCharacter('(int32)83').GetFirstName|Y] enforce his overlord's policy of persecution towards the popular #T Helluvian#! faith, which had come to dominate large parts of eastern and southern #G Ytalia#!. Thus, when his son [GetCharacter('(int32)127').GetFirstName|Y] came to the throne, it came as a surprise when he promoted tolerance amongst the small kingdom, even pardoning and releasing his brother, [GetCharacter('(int32)126').GetName|Y], a devout #T Helluvian#!.

Despite having abandoned his faith, [GetCharacter('(int32)127').GetFirstName|Y] still maintained the #T Cult of Zanis#! as the state religion to placate his overlord, who chafed at the disobediance shown by the young King. For many more radical believers, this was unacceptable. Rumors of rebellion now linger amongst isolated #T Helluvian#! communities, who scoff at the idea of the emperor in [GetProvince('(int32)2478').GetName|G] dictating the fate of their eternal souls.

With unrest building in the eastern regions, can [GetCharacter('(int32)127').GetName|Y] maintain control of his kingdom, or will #G Ytalia#! finally seek its own path free from #Y Zanic#! oppression?"

name: Norraksgaelg
code:
lorestart.33.desc: "Ever since King [GetCharacter('(int32)136').GetFirstName|Y]'s conquest of [GetProvince('(int32)1199').GetName|G], the #G Kingdom of Herue#! has been the most prominent player amongst the various warring Norrfalian tribes. Founded upon the ruins of the #Y Drow#! kingdom of Iolsim, #G Herue#! has stood as a bastion of #T Helluvianism#! and humanity against the hostile #Y Drow#! who thirst to avenge those fallen during the #Y Svardenni#!. However, the last few decades have brought this once-mighty kingdom to it's knees, and while her sons fight each other for possesion of the #T Iron Crown#!, the #Y Drow#! watch hungrily for a chance to reconquer their lost lands.

In the year 987 LC, King [GetCharacter('(int32)141').GetFirstName|Y], head of the renown #Y Walantidottir#! dynasty, died. While the crown is de jure passed onto an appointed heir, Herulian tradition consistently affirms primogeniture, and since the days of [GetCharacter('(int32)136').GetFirstName|Y] the #Y Walantidottir#! have appointed their first-born as their heir. The deceased king broke this tradition, appointing his youngest son, [GetCharacter('(int32)143').GetFirstName|Y], as his primary heir, leaving minor duchies to his other sons.

Those around the young king were known to say that he, 'would have been a better scholar than a ruler'. This sentiment led many to question his right to rule, and held weight amongst those who supported pretenders to the throne. The brothers [GetCharacter('(int32)145').GetFirstName|Y] and [GetCharacter('(int32)146').GetFirstName|Y] agreed to an alliance to make a play for the throne, and launched a rebellion the following year. By fall of 988 LC they had managed to take [GetProvince('(int32)1199').GetName|G] with the help of sympathetic nobles, banishing the disgraced king to [GetProvince('(int32)1303').GetName|G] with those few who still followed him. With victory all but assured the greedy brothers turned on each other, fracturing the realm once again.

This civil war sewed chaos across the north. Surrounding norfallian tribes took advantage of the infighting to raid and pillage Herulian lands, while many #Y Balthazarian Knights#! fought on all sides of the conflict, weakening the Order's authority. This came to a head when a large force of invading #Y Drow#! defeated a large host of Balthazarian Knights at the Battle of [GetProvince('(int32)1078').GetName|G] in 993 LC.

The #Y Drow#! ravaged the lands outside of their caves, spurring many norrfalians to take up their #T Blood-Stained#! religion, since the weakened Order could not save them. The brothers made a brief peace to combat this threat, winning a phyrric victory against the #Y Drow#! at [GetProvince('(int32)1228').GetName|G] in 996 LC that cost the experienced Grandmaster his life.

While the #Y Walantidottir#! recovered from the battle, the last member of the #Y Docsjaldutson#! family, a cadet branch of the #Y Walantidottir#! dynasty, [GetCharacter('(int32)144').GetFirstName|Y] made his play for the throne. [GetCharacter('(int32)144').GetFirstName|Y] had won the hearts of the people as the head of the Crimson Army, made of veteran soldiers followed him to victory against the various invading tribes during the civil war, defending the borders of #G Herue#! while the #Y Walantidottir#! ravaged the realm. [GetCharacter('(int32)144').GetFirstName|Y] swiftly conquered [GetProvince('(int32)1199').GetName|G] and claimed the #T Iron Crown#! for himself. Recognizing the threat this outsider posed, the two #Y Walantidottir#! brothers once again formed an alliance to defend their dynasty's rightful lands. Seeking to avoid more bloodshed and knowing all sides in this conflict would be too distracted to stop them, the merchants of the port cities of [GetProvince('(int32)1331').GetName|G] and [GetProvince('(int32)1230').GetName|G] declared independence, ensuring that the inland towns of #G Herue#! would be cut off from the wider #Y Luxterran#! world.

With four claimants to the #T Iron Crown#! on the cusp of war, the [GetCountry('BLZ').GetName|Y] in disarray, and the #Y Drow#! preparing a larger, more organized invasion, only #Y Hellas#! knows the future of #G Norrfalia#!."

name: O-Dzuzpun
code: lorestart.46.desc: "Protests and riots have erupted in the streets of [GetProvince('(int32)2478').GetName|Y] following the execution of [GetCharacter('(int32)129').GetName|Y], or #Y 'Zorgolis of Gevanni'#!, at dawn today. The crowds refuse to disperse and there have been numerous fires set throughout the streets of the capital - things are getting worse by the minute and could spiral out of our control.\n\nThe famed writer and orator spent his final years writing his memoirs in #G 'Tales from the Zanic Age'#! in a dungeon under charges of treason, sentenced to death after unsuccessfully agitating for land reforms to benefit soldiers returning from war. The common people demand justice, while the landed aristocracy, nervous about what they have already lost and vowing not to lose anything more, demands we maintain order with an iron fist. How shall we handle the public unrest in our capital?"
